jobs.title: Public Sector Strategic Account Executive, SLED - Great Lakes
AEO/GEO/SEO Lead
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Search is being rebuilt in real time. Millions of people now start with a question to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity, and the answer they get decides which products they try. When someone asks how to build an app, a website, or a tool for their business, Replit needs to be the answer.

We're hiring an AEO/GEO/SEO Lead to own how Replit gets discovered, across AI-generated answers and traditional search. This is a zero-to-one role. You'll define the strategy, then execute it yourself with AI-leveraged production, agency partners, and cross-functional teams behind you. You'll work daily with our Web, Growth, Brand, Content, Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams.

The fastest-growing AI-native companies have already turned AI answers into a primary acquisition channel. Your mandate is to do the same for Replit: grow AI referral traffic into one of our largest sources of new builders, keep our traditional search presence compounding, and make Replit the platform AI assistants recommend when anyone wants to build software.

Replit moves fast. We ship continuously, experiment relentlessly, and aim to make every builder more productive and creative. We're looking for someone who thrives in that environment: part strategist, part operator, part scientist of a channel that changes every month.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the AEO/GEO Strategy Define where Replit must show up across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, for which prompts and buyer intents, and build the playbook to win those answers. Set targets, sequence the roadmap, and defend the strategy with data.

 - Win Citations Across the Open Web LLMs cite what they trust: Reddit threads, YouTube videos, high-authority publications, community content, and well-structured owned pages. Build durable programs on each of these surfaces, understand the half-life of an AI citation, and keep Replit ranked as models retrain and retrieval systems shift.

 - Run SEO End to End Own keyword strategy, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and content-driven organic growth in partnership with our Head of Web. Protect and grow search equity through a major site relaunch, and coordinate with our paid search team on keyword coverage.

 - Build the Content Engine Produce and direct content designed for two readers at once: LLM crawlers and humans. Blogs, comparison pages, videos, and structured resources, created at volume with AI-assisted workflows and held to a high quality bar. The durable human work here is judgment: strategy, editorial quality, and distribution.

 - Stand Up Measurement Build reporting for a channel that lacks perfect attribution: AI referral traffic, share of voice in AI answers, citation tracking, and downstream signups and revenue. Run controlled experiments, isolate what actually moves citations, and teach the rest of the company what you learn.

 - Direct Agencies and Tools Own our agency and vendor relationships across search and AI visibility, plus the tool stack that powers tracking and production. Write the briefs, hold the quality bar, and decide what stays in-house.
   



YOU'LL BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

 - Have 5+ years in SEO, organic growth, or content-driven acquisition (ideally within SaaS, technology, or developer-focused businesses), including hands-on AEO/GEO work within the last year

 - Can show real results: AI referral traffic you grew, citations you won, rankings you moved, and how you measured all of it

 - Are technically fluent in SEO: keyword research, crawling, indexing, structured data, site architecture, and log analysis

 - Understand how LLMs actually retrieve and cite sources, and how that differs across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity

 - Write clearly and quickly, and can direct people, agencies, and AI tools to produce content that earns citations

 - Are analytical enough to build credible measurement in a messy, fast-changing channel, connecting organic visibility to traffic, signups, product adoption, and revenue

 - Are comfortable partnering with engineering, product, content, and analytics stakeholders to get changes shipped in a fast-moving environment

 - Love building from scratch: frameworks, processes, and strategy

 - Have a founder mindset: you identify gaps and fill them, move quickly, and don't wait for someone else to define the playbook

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach and willingness to dig into the details
   



BONUS POINTS:

 - Made AI answers a primary acquisition channel at a PLG, consumer, or developer-facing software company

 - Deep Reddit fluency: you understand how communities work and how to earn credible presence there

 - Experience running YouTube as an organic discovery channel

 - Hands-on with AI visibility and citation tracking tools (Profound, Peec, Ahrefs Brand Radar, or similar)

 - Programmatic SEO at meaningful scale

 - You've built with Replit or other AI building tools and understand our builders firsthand

 - Experience directing SEO/AEO agencies and fractional specialists



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
jobs.description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• Pro-active, motivated and eager to learn and grow in fast paced working environment
• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues
• Fluent in English (French or German would be considered as an advantage)
• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills and able to work under tight deadlines
• The candidate will receive training and coaching required and it is not expected that the candidate hold any material prior experience, however, basic understanding of Lux GAAP and IFRS

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

Learn more about Langham Hall by visiting our website: https://www.langhamhall.com/

Apply Now

Cyber Security Analyst – Audit

Luxembourg OR Amsterdam, Netherlands
Monday – Friday 8:00 am – 5:00 pm OR 9:00 am – 6:00 pm
Hybrid

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst – Audit to support and enhance the organization's security posture across multiple jurisdictions. This role is responsible for executing audit activities, strengthening compliance frameworks, and aligning security strategies across both legacy and modern technology environments. The candidate will work closely with audit partners and internal stakeholders to ensure adherence to audit and regulatory requirements and continuous improvement of security assurance practices.

The ideal candidate has at least four years of experience in cybersecurity, IT audit, risk management, or compliance. This role ensures adherence to global regulatory standards (e.g., SOX, GDPR, ISO), evaluates control effectiveness, and serves as a primary liaison for auditors. The role requires strong risk assessment capabilities, proactive issue resolution, and a balanced focus on compliance and enterprise resilience in tandem with security leadership.

Some of the things that you will be doing:

• Partner with global teams across business operations, compliance, IT, and legal to manage technology risk and regulatory compliance.
• Plan and execute internal, external, and jurisdictional audits in line with the audit roadmap.
• Develop and enhance security policies, standards, procedures, and compliance frameworks.
• Improve IT compliance processes and identify automation opportunities for control activities.
• Design and execute control testing strategies and ensure proper evidence documentation.
• Maintain and enhance control frameworks aligned with regulatory and industry standards.
• Conduct IT risk assessments and track remediation of identified gaps.
• Coordinate with auditors, regulators, and stakeholders during audit cycles.
• Track and report compliance metrics and program effectiveness indicators.
• Leverage GRC tools for audit management, evidence tracking, and reporting.
• Identify risks and vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies.
• Manage third-party/vendor risk assessments and escalations.
• Respond to regulatory and jurisdictional audit requests.
• Provide actionable insights and reporting to security leadership.

What technical skills, experience and qualifications do you need?

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, or related field (or equivalent experience).
• 4+ years of experience in IT audit, risk management, or cybersecurity.
• Strong knowledge of Global regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GDPR, ISO, DORA PCI, PSD2 and NIST.
• Familiarity with audit standards and frameworks (SOC 1 & 2, ISO 27001, NIST, COSO, COBIT).
• Understanding of cybersecurity threat landscape and control environments.
• Knowledge of modern technologies including cloud, DevOps, application security, and AI.
• Experience working with/ customizing GRC tools (e.g., Archer, OneTrust, AuditBoard, Diligent).
• Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive approach towards available work requests and timely response.
• Ability to translate technical risks into business insights.
• Hands-on experience in IT disciplines and audit execution.
• Experience in global and multi-regulatory environments.
• Ability to manage complex compliance requirements across jurisdictions.
• Strong organizational and proactive risk management skills.
• High integrity, accountability, and professional excellence.
• CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CIA, or other relevant cybersecurity, audit, or risk certifications.

Pwc Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Associate - Deals (Mergers & Acquisitions) (m/f/d). What if it was you?  
  
Your mission: PwC's Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) Advisory team supports clients across the full transaction lifecycle, helping them assess strategic alternatives and execute complex transactions with confidence. We advise corporate, private equity and entrepreneurial clients on sell-side and buy-side transactions, mergers, joint ventures, divestitures, capital raisings and other strategic transactions.
As a Senior Associate in Mergers & Acquisitions (Deals) at PwC, you will be a core member of our M&A advisory team, driving execution-focused support across the full deal lifecycle. You will work with clients and cross-functional PwC teams on buy-side and sell-side mandates, leading financial analysis, valuation and transaction deliverables with a focus on quality, insight, and commercial impact.

Be a part of our team where you will:  

• Lead and support end-to-end M&A execution activities, including financial modelling, valuation (DCF, comparables, precedent transactions), and competitive analysis;
• Prepare high-quality client deliverables such as pitch books, teasers, CIMs, management presentations and transaction recommendations;
• Conduct detailed financial statement analysis;
• Oversee a virtual data room and manage a due diligence process for buy and sell side engagements;
• Supervise and coach junior team members, providing feedback and promoting knowledge sharing;
• Contribute to business development efforts, including proposals and market research.

Let's talk about you. If you …  

• Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in finance, business administration, or a related field;
• Bring 3–5 years of relevant experience in M&A advisory, investment banking, Big 4 transaction services, corporate finance, or a similar environment within a leading advisory or investment banking platform;
• Possess strong technical skills in valuation, financial modelling, and transaction structuring;
• Communicate confidently and effectively, with the ability to engage C suite executives, investors, and buyers;
• Have a solid academic background and, ideally, relevant professional certifications;
• Are fluent in English and able to produce polished, professional written and verbal communications;
• Speak Luxembourgish, French, or German - an asset but not a requirement.
• Understand the Luxembourg business and investment ecosystem, or are eager to develop this knowledge.
• Are willing to travel occasionally depending on client and project needs.

…You are the candidate we are looking for!

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

jobs.title: HealthTech Innovation Project Coordinator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


CDD, full-time, ref: [HTIPC26]
Service: National Business Relationship Management
Hierarchical Superior: Director, Business Relationship Management



About Luxinnovation

Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.

Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.


Job mission:


Department description:

The Business Relationship Management division builds and maintains strategic relationships with Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. Within this division, the HealthTech team supports the development and competitiveness of Luxembourg's health technologies sector — spanning medtech, digital health, biotech and pharmaceutical innovation — by connecting companies to relevant programmes, research organisations and European initiatives.


Job description:

As a HealthTech Innovation Project Coordinator, you will drive the operational management and strategic coordination of healthtech-related projects at national and European level. You will coordinate the activities of the HealthTech team members, ensuring that project milestones are delivered on time and within budget, while fostering collaboration between internal colleagues, consortium partners, research organisations and Luxembourg-based companies across the health technologies value chain.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.


Main tasks and responsibilities:

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:


Inspire:

Monitor technological, regulatory and market developments across the healthtech landscape (medtech, digital health, biotech, pharma) and translate insights into actionable opportunities for the ecosystem
Contribute to the design and implementation of Luxinnovation's HealthTech strategy and annual work programme, aligned with national health innovation priorities
Represent Luxinnovation in healthtech-related fora, conferences and working groups at national and European level
Promote Luxembourg's healthtech ecosystem and its competitive advantages to international partners and stakeholders


Assess & Accelerate:

Manage the operational delivery of healthtech innovation projects, ensuring alignment with consortium work plans, KPIs and budgets
Coordinate the contributions of the HealthTech team members across active projects, ensuring clarity of roles, coherent planning and timely delivery of individual and collective workstreams
Track project progress through regular reporting (CRM, European project management systems), flag risks and propose corrective actions
Identify companies' innovation needs within the healthtech sector and assess their potential to participate in collaborative R&D projects
Support companies in navigating regulatory frameworks relevant to health technologies (e.g., EU Medical Device Regulation, European Health Data Space)


Connect:

Serve as the central coordination point within the HealthTech team, facilitating information flow, aligning priorities and ensuring synergies between team members' respective activities and project portfolios
Coordinate with consortium partners, research organisations and institutional stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution and knowledge exchange
Facilitate matchmaking between Luxembourg healthtech companies and international partners for collaborative innovation projects
Act as an internal interface, connecting healthtech project activities with other Luxinnovation services (funding, market intelligence, digitalisation)
Develop and maintain professional relationships across the national and European healthtech ecosystem


Fund:

Support Luxembourg companies in accessing European healthtech funding programmes (Horizon Europe Health Cluster, EIT Health, Innovative Health Initiative, Digital Europe Programme)
Ensure compliant budget tracking, timesheet management and financial reporting for all projects under your coordination
Identify synergies between national RDI funding instruments and European healthtech calls to maximise funding opportunities for ecosystem actors
Contribute to the preparation and submission of new collaborative project proposals in the healthtech domain


This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.


Required competencies:

Education level and professional experience required:

University degree at Master's level (Bac+4/5) in life sciences, biomedical engineering, health economics, public health, business management or equivalent
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in project coordination or management within the healthtech, life sciences or health innovation sector
Proven experience managing multi-partner collaborative projects (national or European)
Experience coordinating small cross-functional teams or workgroups
Knowledge of European R&D programme structures (Horizon Europe, EIT Health, IHI) is a strong asset
Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA) is desirable


Specific competencies:

Solid understanding of the health technologies landscape, including medtech, digital health, biotech and pharmaceutical innovation
Proven ability to manage complex project portfolios with multiple workstreams, partners and deadlines
Strong team coordination skills, with the ability to align diverse contributors around shared objectives and delivery timelines
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical health innovation challenges into structured project plans
Excellent stakeholder engagement and diplomatic skills across institutional, academic and private-sector actors
Knowledge of Luxembourg's socio-economic environment and health innovation ecosystem is an asset
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to health technologies (EU MDR, IVDR, European Health Data Space) is an advantage


Languages:

Fluent English and French are mandatory (oral and written, minimum C1 level)
German and/or Luxembourgish is considered an asset


IT Skills:

MS Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and MS Project or equivalent
CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics)
European project management platforms (e.g., EC Funding & Tenders Portal, JEMS)
Knowledge of collaboration and reporting tools (Teams, SharePoint)


Why choose this position?

This role places you at the intersection of health innovation, European R&D policy and team leadership. You will coordinate a dedicated team of healthtech specialists while managing high-impact projects that accelerate the adoption of health technologies in Luxembourg. Join a collaborative environment where your expertise in project coordination and your passion for healthtech will contribute directly to strengthening Luxembourg's position as a competitive player in the European health innovation landscape.


Application:

Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us! [...]

jobs.description:
Network Relationship Manager (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU

Your area of work:

Within Clearstream, Global Markets – Network Management is responsible for managing Clearstream's worldwide network of financial market infrastructures and service providers, including central securities depositories, custodian banks, cash correspondent banks, and trading venues.
The main responsibilities of Network Management are to select, develop and monitor the global network of third-party service providers for settlement, custody and cash correspondent banking services. The work includes notably the continuous assessment of the levels of service, competitiveness and the associated risks of those markets where Clearstream operates a link. Network Management also ensures at all times compliance with Clearstream|Deutsche Boerse's policies and procedures and their regulatory requirements applicable to the management of its market links and agent bank network.

The Network Management Office (NMO) is a transversal control, coordination and governance function that supports and oversees the Network Management teams globally. Its mandate is not market ownership, but process integrity, consistency, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience across the entire Network Management function. This is a cross functional role combining governance, process management, regulatory awareness, audit coordination, and stakeholder interaction.

Your responsibilities:

• Establishing and monitoring the contractual relationships with Clearstream's third party providers, from leading the RFIs/RFPs to concluding contracts
• Reviewing and negotiating fee schedules, taking into account the market specifics and competition
• Monitoring compliance with all applicable market and regulatory requirements
• Monitoring adherence to operational service levels, from a contractual and competitive standpoint
• Sourcing and communicating all information about allocated markets in a timely and relevant fashion, for all stakeholders
• Performing on-site due diligence visits (a few business trips per year may be necessary)
• Maintaining the evaluation of the market requirements and their risk assessments
• Representing and advocating for Clearstream|Deutsche Boerse in forums and in the interactions with all layers of the markets: participants, regulators, infrastructures, etc.
• Business analysis of Settlement and Custody related products
• Cross-departmental coordination of market developments/projects
• Governance & Oversight: providing a centralised governance and control over the above-mentioned Network Management activities to ensure execution of the Network Management Procedure, acting as a control and coordination layer between regional Network Management teams and other internal stakeholders (audit, compliance, etc)
• Procedures & Regulatory Alignment: responsible for the administration, maintenance and consistency of Network Management procedures that are filed with Clearstream's regulators, coordinating annual and adhoc updates and ensuring the audit and regulatory requirements are correctly documented.
• Audit & Assurance Support: act as the central audit interface for Network Management, coordinating external and internal audit requests and ensuring evidence, documentation and controls are consistently available.
• Process Coordinationg & Steering: organise and coordinate Network Management Steering Committees in order to facilitate internal alignment on processes, controls and priorities, supporting the escalation and alignment of transversal issues affecting the Network Management team as a whole
• Systems & Data Governance: supporting the consistent usage of the Network Management system (DigiNet) plus other systems and tools available to the team, to ensure quality data standards and disciplined documentation storage practices.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree, post-graduate degree or MBA, in economics / finance or equivalent
• 3-5 years of securities services experience or any equivalent financial enviornment
• Background in governance, operational risk, compliance, audit coordination, or process management
• Experience working with cross border or distributed teams is an advantage
• Strong organisational and coordination skills
• High attention to detail and structured working style
• Ability to understand complex processes and translate them into clear frameworks
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Confidence interacting with senior stakeholders and control functions
• Strong negotiation, presentation and analytical skills, enabling the interactions with all levels of management, internally and with clients and service providers.
• Ability to represent Clearstream|Deutsche Boerse's agenda and interests with industry participants and bodies, including the relevant regulators.
• Ability to set and prioritize objectives, to contribute to the wider departmental and organisational objectives, to proactively source, interact or develop talent, collaborate with the team and across the company. Able to work independently, be a team player, and offer up effective recommendations to management or counterparts.
• Understanding of compliance with regulations applicable to securities and cash services, remaining current as regulatory agendas evolve.
• Very comfortable and effective at running meetings, interfacing in culturally diverse environments, with teams and colleagues working across multiple time zones, and with global partners and clients.
• Spoken and written fluency in business English is a mandatory requirement. Proficiency in additional languages, are advantageous.
• Effective knowledge of MS office products (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word), SAP and SWIFT very beneficial.

jobs.title: Regional General Manager, DACH
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




WHO WE ARE:

This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for Germany, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution.

 - Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions.

 - Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to German customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making.

 - Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion.

 - Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across Germany.

 - Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions.

 - Make agentic transformation central to the German GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption.

 - Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value.

 - Build “sell with” partner motions in Germany, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning.

 - Establish Notion as a visible force in the German ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy.

 - Represent the voice of German customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics.

 - Create a talent destination in Germany by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent.

 - Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in Germany and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent.

You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow.

You are excited by Notion’s shift to an AI-native, country-first GTM model and believe the best GTM teams will increasingly be builders: BDRs who identify transformation opportunities, Solutions Consultants who build with customers in the room, Outcomes Architects who turn early workflows into durable adoption, and Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers who design the technical systems behind complex agentic workflows.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in Germany.

 - Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams.

 - Track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets across new business, expansion, and renewal/churn dynamics.

 - Deep knowledge of the German enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics.

 - Experience building or scaling a regional/country business in a high-growth or ambiguous environment.

 - Experience selling, implementing, or leading GTM teams around AI, automation, agentic workflows, collaboration, productivity, developer, or data products.

 - Strong strategic judgment: ability to define a country plan, segment the market, prioritize accounts and plays, and align cross-functional teams around outcomes.

 - Operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline generation, inspection, performance management, territory planning, and sales process.

 - Executive presence with CIO, CTO, CPO, COO, and business transformation buyers, with the ability to shape a compelling AI and agentic workflow narrative.

 - Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product.

 - Builder mentality and deep AI curiosity: comfortable learning, demoing, and coaching teams on agent-first workflows, proof-of-value motions, and customer co-building.

 - Fluency in German and English.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience launching or scaling a country-first or regional GTM operating model.

 - Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, APIs, webhooks, connectors, data residency, AI governance, and technical evaluation processes.

 - Experience scaling partner, channel, marketplace, or consultant-led GTM motions around AI or workflow transformation.

- Lead or assist in all project phases: conception, design, customizing, prototyping, and roll-out of SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA solutions.
- Analyze, optimize, and improve processes in public sector finance.
- Ensure functional and technical feasibility of SAP solutions.
- Collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to deliver high-quality SAP services.
- Contribute to knowledge transfer and best practices within the SAP team.

- Sicherstellung der fachlichen und technischen Umsetzbarkeit von SAP-Lösungen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und internen Teams, um hochwertige SAP-Services bereitzustellen.
- Mitwirkung beim Wissensaustausch und der Weitergabe von Best Practices innerhalb des SAP-Teams.

Qualifications

- Completed degree in Business Administration, Business Informatics, or equivalent qualification with relevant professional experience
- Proven experience in SAP consulting, ideally in SAP PSM and PSCD modules
- Solid knowledge of Public Sector Management (PSM) processes and SAP PSCD
- Experience in SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA projects, including conception, design, customizing, prototyping, and roll-out
- Knowledge of SAP FI and SAP S/4HANA Finance is a plus
- Fluent German (C1) and good English skills
- Flexible and willing to travel (20% up to 40%)

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der SAP-Beratung, idealerweise in den Modulen SAP PSM und PSCD.

Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

jobs.description:

Vom Sauerland in die Welt - wir bei KettenWulf sind ein internationales Team, das gemeinsam über alle Ebenen zielorientiert am Erfolg arbeitet. Als mittelständisches Familienunternehmen in der vierten Generation sind wir ein sicherer Arbeitgeber und bieten Raum für individuelle Entwicklung.

KettenWulf produziert schon bereits seit 100 Jahren Förderketten, Antriebsketten und Kettenräder für die unterschiedlichsten Branchen und gehört zu den führenden Markenherstellern. Besonders die Qualität unserer Produkte liegt uns am Herzen.

Unsere Arbeitskultur:

Kurze Dienstwege, transparente Prozesse und flache Hierarchien sowie eine offene und ehrliche Umgangsweise miteinander zeichnet das KettenWulf Team aus. Zahlreiche Benefits wie die betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Bike-Leasing sowie regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents unterstreichen die große Wertschätzung gegenüber unseren Mitarbeitenden.

- Pflege und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenbeziehungen in den Ländern Spanien und Portugal
- Akquisition von Neukunden und Kooperationspartnern
- Technische und kaufmännische Kundenberatung und Ausarbeitung individueller Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktmanagement
- Begleitung unserer Kunden bei Auslegung der Anlagen in der Planungs- und Konstruktionsphase
- Betreuung unserer Kunden bei Umrüstung und Modernisierung von Anlagen
- Führen von Angebots- und Auftragsverhandlungen
- Technische Ausarbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Anfragen
- Mitwirken an Messeveranstaltungen und Marketingmaßnahmen
- Erarbeitung von Marktanalysen und Ableitung von erforderlichen Maßnahmen

Ihr Profil

- Abschluss als Ingenieur, Wirtschaftsingenieur oder Techniker in der Fachrichtung Maschinenbau
- Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung mit technischen Produkten
- Kaufmännisches Denken
- Flexibilität, hohe Einsatzbereitschaft
- Selbstständige, zielorientierte, proaktive und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Hohe Reisebereitschaft
- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Gute Portugiesisch- und Spanischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Wir bieten Ihnen

- Eine intensive Einarbeitung in ein breites, interessantes und vielseitiges Aufgabenfeld
- Die Mitarbeit in einem internationalen, mittelständischen Familienunternehmen
- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position bei einem etablierten Marktführer für Ketten und Kettenräder
- Einen hohen Grad an Eigenverantwortung der Raum lässt zur selbstbestimmten zielgerichteten Organisation der Tätigkeit

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, Benelux
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.

 

This role is based in Dublin, Ireland. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in Dutch

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets
   
   
   
    

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. Are you a relationship builder with a passion for driving growth? Management Events is seeking Key Client Managers and Network Growth Managers to join our team. You will play a pivotal role in expanding our network of high-level decision-makers. How do these roles contribute to the company's growth?

As a Key Client Manager, you will focus on building and maintaining strong relationships with existing C-suite clients.

jobs.description:

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Lead the certification lifecycle, ensuring game certifications, re-certifications, and market-specific regulatory documentation remain accurate and up to date.
    Ensure games, promotions, configurations, and operational activities comply with jurisdictional and regulatory requirements before release.
    Coordinate regulatory documentation with Compliance, DEVS, Projects, testing laboratories, and game providers.
    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.
    Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, coordinating evidence, and following up on audit actions.
    Create, maintain, and continuously improve compliance procedures, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory documentation.
    Ensure compliance documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with regulatory requirements and operational workflows.
    Support the development of compliance-related Knowledge Base articles and onboarding material.
    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.
    Maintain sufficient operational knowledge to provide support across Product Operations where required and contribute to business continuity.
    Perform any other task or responsibility related or connected to the role.

Additional Responsibilities

    Reporting, Improvement & Coordination
    Audit Readiness & Compliance Documentation

Who and what we are after?

    Minimum of 3 years’ experience within the iGaming industry in Compliance, Product Operations, Certification Management, QA, or a similar operational role.
    Demonstrated experience managing regulatory documentation, certifications, audits, or compliance-related processes.
    Good understanding of casino games, game certifications, regulated markets, and operational compliance requirements.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
    Experience developing or maintaining compliance documentation, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory procedures.
    Experience supporting or leading process improvement and operational governance initiatives.
    Comfortable working with compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and operational metrics.
    An interest in automation and AI-assisted operational processes.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and regulated environment.
    Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and operational discipline.
    Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team while also working independently and taking ownership of allocated responsibilities.

Employee benefits

    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast and lunch prepared every day in our penthouse kitchen – you can save up to €3,000 a year
    Birthday leave – as we want you to celebrate your day

jobs.title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
jobs.description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Meet the criteria? Apply today and become part of the Immense Group journey.

jobs.title: Safariopas / asiakaspalvelija – talvikausi 2026–2027
jobs.description:
Haemme vahvistusta Pyhä Safariksen tiimiin ensi talvikaudelle!

Etsimme reipasta, oma-aloitteista ja asiakaslähtöistä henkilöä, joka viihtyy sekä Lapin luonnossa että asiakaspalvelun parissa. Työ on monipuolinen yhdistelmä **safarioppaan tehtäviä sekä safaritalollamme tapahtuvaa front desk -asiakaspalvelua**.

Safarioppaana

Safarioppaana työskentely Pyhä Safariksella on hyvin monipuolista. Voit toimia oppaana esimerkiksi erilaisilla moottorikelkkasafareilla, viedä asiakkaita poro- tai huskysafareille tai lähteä ryhmän kanssa pilkille, lumikenkäilemään tai sähköläskipyöräretkelle.

Meillä on myös oma jääkarting-rata, jolla järjestämme vauhdikkaita karting-kilpailuja.

Oppaan työssä pääset tutustuttamaan asiakkaitamme Lapin luontoon ja toimimaan paikallisoppaana. Työpäivät koostuvat aktiviteettien valmistelusta ja toteuttamisesta sekä erilaisista siivous-, huolto- ja varustetehtävistä.

Asiakaspalvelussa

Työskentelet yhdessä muun asiakaspalvelutiimimme kanssa safaritalollamme Pyhän keskustassa. Tehtäviin kuuluu asiakkaiden vastaanottamista, retkien ja aktiviteettien myyntiä, varusteiden vuokrausta sekä sähköposteihin ja puheluihin vastaamista.

Vuokraamme muun muassa moottorikelkkoja, sähköläskipyöriä ja lumikenkiä. Käytössämme ovat FareHarbor- ja Travius-varausjärjestelmät.

Meillä on safaritalollamme oma myyjä/front desk -työntekijä, joten sinun ei tarvitse vastata vastaanotosta yksin. Hänen poissa ollessaan pystyt kuitenkin tarvittaessa hoitamaan vastaanottoa itsenäisesti.

Työtehtävien painotus vaihtelee sesongin ja varaustilanteen mukaan.

Toivomme sinulta

- erinomaista asiakaspalveluasennetta

- reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

- hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

- valmiutta työskennellä iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin

- kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä

- kiinnostusta Lapin luontoon, ulkoiluun ja ohjelmapalveluihin


Aikaisempi kokemus safarioppaan, ohjelmapalveluiden tai asiakaspalvelun tehtävistä on eduksi. Myös aktiivinen harrastuneisuus esimerkiksi eräilystä, moottorikelkkailusta, pilkkimisestä, lumikenkäilystä, pyöräilystä tai moottoriurheilusta katsotaan eduksi.

Ensiaputaidot, hyvä aluetuntemus ja ajokokemus ovat plussaa. Myös FareHarbor- ja Travius-varausjärjestelmien tuntemus sekä soveltuva matkailualan koulutus ovat eduksi.

**Koulutamme tarvittaessa tehtävään – tärkeintä meille on hyvä asenne ja halu oppia.**

Tarjoamme

- monipuolisen työn Lapin matkailun parissa

- vaihtelevia työpäiviä sisällä ja ulkona

- mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisesti erilaisten aktiviteettien parissa

- kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen kokemuksesi mukaan

- perehdytyksen ja koulutuksen tehtäviin

- edullisen majoituksen kausityöntekijälle

- mukavan ja pienen työyhteisön, jossa pääset tekemään monipuolisesti erilaisia työtehtäviä


Työsuhde on ohjelmapalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukainen määräaikainen kausityö. Työ alkaa marras–joulukuussa 2026 ja jatkuu arviolta maaliskuun loppuun 2027.

**Työaika on 90–120 tuntia / 3 viikkoa**, ja työaika sekä työtehtävien painotus vaihtelevat sesongin ja varaustilanteen mukaan. Työssä noudatetaan ohjelmapalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaista työajan tasoittumisjärjestelmää.

Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

**Tervetuloa mukaan Pyhä Safariksen tiimiin!**

jobs.title: Rogerz søger butikschef til Danmarks førende trading card game butik
jobs.description:
Er du vores nye Store Manager i Danmarks førende TCG-butik?

Hos Rogerz søger vi en erfaren og engageret Store Manager til vores nye flagship store i Lyngby Storcenter. En leder, der motiveres af mennesker, drift og resultater, og som har lyst til at tage det samlede ansvar for en af vores vigtigste butikker.

Rogerz er en af Nordens hurtigst voksende virksomheder inden for TCG, Sportskort og samleobjekter. Vi specialiserer os i samlekort, tilbehør og collectibles fra blandt andet Pokémon, One Piece, Topps, Disney, Star Wars, Magic: The Gathering og mange flere!

Vi er selv samlere og entusiaster helt ind til benet, og passionen for produkterne og miljøet er en stor del af vores kultur.

Af samlere, for samlere.

Vi driver allerede to fysiske butikker i Fields samt Rødovre Centrum, og nu søger vi den rette person til at tage det overordnede ansvar i vores nye butik i Lyngby Storcenter med ansvar for den daglige drift, udvikling og team.

Din rolle som Store Manager

Som Store Manager bliver du ansvarlig for både mennesker, drift og performance i butikken.

Dine primære ansvarsområder bliver blandt andet:

  • Daglig ledelse og drift af butikken

  • Personaleansvar for butikkens medarbejdere

  • Rekruttering, onboarding og oplæring af nye medarbejdere

  • Udarbejdelse og løbende optimering af vagtplaner

  • Træning, coaching og udvikling af medarbejderne inden for salg, kundeservice og produktviden

  • Sikring af en høj og ensartet kundeoplevelse

  • Opfølgning på butikkens KPI'er og salgsresultater

  • Ansvar for at butikkens løn-, bemandings- og øvrige driftsbudgetter overholdes

  • Arbejde aktivt med salgsudvikling, produktivitet og performance i teamet

  • Sikre at butikkens procedurer, standarder og retningslinjer bliver fulgt

  • Udvikle og implementere nye initiativer og koncepter i tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ledelse

Kort sagt bliver det dit ansvar at sikre, at butikken fungerer optimalt, at teamet præsterer og udvikler sig, og at vores kunder får den oplevelse, vi ønsker at være kendt for.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du allerede har erfaring fra en lignende rolle inden for retail, hvor du har haft ansvar for både medarbejdere og den daglige drift.

Det er vigtigt for os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med personaleledelse og udvikling af medarbejdere

  • Har erfaring med rekruttering og onboarding

  • Er vant til at arbejde med vagtplanlægning og bemandingsoptimering

  • Har forståelse for budgetter og omkostningsstyring

  • Kan arbejde struktureret med KPI'er, salgstal og performance

  • Er synlig og nærværende som leder på butiksgulvet

  • Kan skabe struktur og samtidig bevare energien i en travl hverdag

  • Tager ansvar og følger op på de ting, du sætter i gang

Er du allerede interesseret i Pokémon, Magic, sportskort eller TCG generelt, er det selvfølgelig et plus.

Det er dog ikke et krav. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære produkterne og den verden, vores kunder og medarbejdere brænder for.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Rogerz bliver du en del af en virksomhed i kraftig vækst, hvor der stadig er kort fra bunken, som endnu ikke er vendt.

Det betyder, at du får mulighed for at påvirke både din egen butik og den måde, vi udvikler vores retail-organisation på.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med virksomhedens øverste ledelse og ejerkreds og får derfor kort vej fra idé til handling.

jobs.title: Ammattitaitoinen automekaanikko
jobs.description:
Etsimme osaavaa ja luotettavaa automekaanikkoa Helsingin Pitäjänmäkeen. Tavoitteena on löytää oikea henkilö vakituiseen ja pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Haemme ennen kaikkea tekijää, joka oikeasti osaa työnsä. Arvostamme kokemusta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä ratkaista vikoja itsenäisesti. Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea – palkka ja työnkuva rakennetaan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

Palkka 1 500–3 500 € / kk. Palkka määräytyy osaamisen, kokemuksen ja työajan mukaan. Kokeneelle ja monipuoliselle ammattilaiselle olemme valmiita maksamaan osaamista vastaavan palkan.

TYÖAUTO MYÖS OMAAN KÄYTTÖÖN

Kun olet osoittanut ammattitaitosi ja luotettavuutesi työssä, saat työauton käyttöösi myös työajan ulkopuolella työsuhde-etuna.

Eli hyvälle ja luotettavalle tekijälle haluamme tarjota muutakin kuin pelkän kuukausipalkan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Kokemusta autojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä

- Hyvää mekaanista osaamista

- Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

- Ongelmanratkaisutaitoa ja kykyä selvittää vikoja

- Huolellista, vastuullista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

- Ajokorttia

- Diagnostiikka- ja sähköosaaminen katsotaan isoksi eduksi


\+ Suomenkielentaitoa ja tarvittaessa englanti (ei pakollinen)

- Asiakaspalvelutaidot ovat plussaa – sinun ei tarvitse olla myyntimies, mutta arvostamme sitä, että osaat tarvittaessa keskustella asiakkaiden kanssa asiallisesti ja ymmärrettävästi.


Koulutus on eduksi, mutta meille todellinen osaaminen, kokemus ja tekemisen taso ratkaisevat enemmän kuin hieno CV.

Etsimme ihmistä, joka haluaa sitoutua työhön pidemmäksi aikaa. Oikean henkilön löydyttyä tarjolla on vakituinen työpaikka.

Työn aloituksesta voidaan sopia joustavasti.

KIINNOSTUITKO?

Laita sähköpostia: info@damautokorjaamo.fi

Emad Kavoosi, puh. 040 366 6613

Laita meille lyhyt esittely itsestäsi ja kerro:

- Millainen kokemus sinulla on autojen korjaamisesta?

- Mitkä huolto- ja korjaustyöt hallitset parhaiten?

- Onko sinulla diagnostiikka- tai sähköosaamista?

- Milloin pystyisit aloittamaan?

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Services Lead (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
WorkNomads is on the hunt for a Head of Digital Transformation to join our team!



Who We Are:

We are building a community where global talent is geographically unleashed, and diversity is celebrated. We champion the freedom of living and working across borders, shaping a nation without a country.

·       Remote engineering services, global impact — expert engineering, design, and business talent in cross-disciplinary project teams.

·       Diversity celebrated — 40+ nationalities, 4 continents, one team.

·       Continuous growth — we invest in you: projects, coliving, community, pushing you beyond what you thought possible.



Your mission at WorkNomads:

The Digital Transformation Services Lead is responsible for reimagining and modernizing Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service delivery by introducing digital, AI-enabled, and architecture-led operating models. Leveraging an enterprise architecture background, this role bridges business strategy, technology, and operations to transform how services are designed, delivered, measured, and continuously improved.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Service Transformation Strategy

Define and execute the digital transformation strategy for customer service accounts and managed services.

Design future-state operating models that leverage AI, automation, analytics, cloud technologies, and digital platforms.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles to align business capabilities, processes, applications, data, and technology with strategic objectives.

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.



Innovation & New Ways of Working

Introduce proven operational and digital practices from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, and technology into the BPO environment.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Influence senior executives and client stakeholders on transformation priorities and investment decisions.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

Build strong collaboration between business and IT to ensure successful execution.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

Enterprise Architecture experience with a strong understanding of business architecture, application architecture, data architecture, and technology architecture.

10+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, IT strategy, or service transformation.

Experience within BPO, customer operations, shared services, managed services, or large-scale service organizations.

Demonstrated success leading digital transformation initiatives involving AI, automation, cloud, analytics, and modern enterprise platforms.

Experience leading technology teams and influencing enterprise-wide transformation programs.

Knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF) is an advantage.

Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, ITIL, Lean, Six Sigma, or Product Operating Models is preferred.

jobs.title: Praktik med indflydelse - Udforsk konsulentbranchen med Silverlining Research
jobs.description:
Er du interesseret i at anvende dine metodiske og teoretiske færdigheder til at skabe værdifulde indsigter? Ønsker du at blive en del af et engageret team, hvor vi skaber resultater i fællesskab? Så er et praktikophold hos Silverlining Research oplagt for dig.

Som praktikant hos Silverlining Research bliver du del af en nyere, men veletableret analysevirksomhed. Du arbejder med et bredt spektrum af projekter, herunder evalueringer, markedsanalyser, forretningsudvikling, business intelligence og omfattende tracking-studier for en varieret kundebase, der spænder fra små til store virksomheder i sektorer såsom det offentlige, attraktioner, turisme og luftfart.

Vi søger to nysgerrige praktikanter til forårssemestret 2027 til vores team i Aarhus. Praktikforløbet er som udgangspunkt fuldtid fra 1. februar til 30. juni, men er fleksibelt og aftales individuelt, så det tager højde for forskellige studieordninger.

Du er formentlig i gang med kandidaten på en samfundsfaglig uddannelse. Vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele fra starten, og vi hjælper dig naturligvis godt på vej.

Det kommer du til at arbejde med

  • Gennemførelse af desk research og kvalitative interviews.

  • Udvikling af spørgeskemaer og interviewguides.

  • Kvalitetssikring og analyse af kvantitative og kvalitative data.

  • Rapportering i PowerPoint, Word og Business Intelligence-systemer.

  • Deltagelse i tilbudsskrivning, udvikling af projektdesigns, kundemøder og præsentationer

Det håber vi, du kan sige ja til

  • Praktisk erfaring med håndtering af datasæt og med statistisk analysesoftware, for eksempel R, SPSS, Stata eller SAS.

  • Teoretisk erfaring med kvantitativ analyse, herunder frekvenser, krydstabeller og databehandling.

  • Eventuel erfaring med kvalitative tilgange, for eksempel dybdeinterviews og fokusgrupper.

  • Lyst til at være del af et team, der leverer høj kvalitet i alle aspekter af projektløsningen.

  • Analytisk, løsningsorienteret og en støttende kollega.

Hvad vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en mindre virksomhed med høje vækstrater, store ambitioner og et stærkt fællesskab, og du får indflydelse på projekter og kunder i såvel indland som udland.

Vi har et uformelt miljø med højt til loftet og en høj grad af fleksibilitet og selvtilrettelæggelse. Gennem forløbet har du løbende opfølgning med to mentorer, som hjælper dig med at få mest muligt ud af tiden hos os. Du får din daglige gang på kontoret i Navitas, hvor der er god kaffe, kantine og udsigt over havet, havnen og byen, samt jævnlige sociale arrangementer i og udenfor huset.

Praktikken er lønnet og der er gode muligheder for videre ansættelse som studentermedhjælper efter endt praktikperiode.

Ansøg nu

Send din ansøgning, CV og karakterudskrifter til Nanna Andersen på na@silverliningresearch.com eller ring på 42 40 70 77. Læs mere om os på www.silverliningresearch.com. Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende og lukker ansættelsesrunden, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!
