jobs.title: Lead engineer - mechanical design m/f (h/f)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Electronics & Defense est une entreprise internationale de plus de 19 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, qui mobilisent expertises et esprit de corps pour concevoir des solutions de haute technologie dans les domaines de l'aéronautique, de la défense et du spatial. En combinant intelligence humaine et technologique, l'entreprise développe des produits et services pour les acteurs du monde civil et militaires, sur terre, en mer, dans le ciel et dans l'espace.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.



Descriptif mission
Overview:

In this role, the Lead Engineer (Mechanical Design) will actively participate in conceptual and detailed design of NPI (New Product Introduction), redesign and technology programs of Safran Electronics & Defense business unit and will support various Actuation Systems product lines including Power Door Opening System (PDOS), Thrust Reverser Actuation Systems (TRAS) and Highlift Flap and Slat Actuation systems.



Position: Lead Engineer (P2) - Mechanical Design



Primary Responsibilities:



o Understand system requirements, design intent, and comply with applicable design practices, aerospace standards, customer requirements and regulatory requirements.

o Contribute and implement the design and development of engineering solutions taking account of critical constraints for cost, safety, and sustainability.

o Perform trade study involving conflicting demands from engineering functions (stress, reliability, Performance).

o Carry out conceptual design and detailed design (modelling and drafting) for NPI, Technology programs and value engineering

o Apply GD&T and perform tolerance stack-up analysis for components/Sub-systems.

o Provide inputs to improve Processes, tools, methods, and products

o Design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM and DFA) and optimize the design for cost reduction, weight reduction, mistake proofing, material selection.

o Perform design failure mode and effects analyses

o Support manufacturing concessions and engineering change requests

o Self-motivated and keen to get involved in new technologies and projects and learn new skills to map out future career path.

o Actively participate in a team environment and work with customers, suppliers, and cross functional teams for product development

o Develop optimized product design by challenging existing design and ideas and by offering innovative ideas.

o Ensure design works are done in time and with the required details and quality

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Content Onboarding
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Content Onboarding team builds the systems that help customers move content into Notion, get started faster, and keep growing reliably over time. The role matters because one of Notion’s core differentiators is replacing multiple tools — and that only becomes real when customers can get their information out of those tools and into Notion with confidence. You’ll partner with product and engineering leaders to shape the future of our content importers, internal administrative tooling, and compliance workflows like exports.

This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Shape the technical and product vision for Notion’s import systems, so customers can pull content from more sources and transform it into a trustworthy system of record.

 - By your 90th day, you’ll have clarified the near-term roadmap and de-risked the most important technical decisions for importers, exports, and internal admin tooling. You’ll connect AI-era and agentic workflow patterns to onboarding and import experiences — using AI to improve product judgment, prototyping, and engineering quality from design through production.

 - By the end of your first year, engineering excellence will be a team norm: reliable systems, clear operational standards, and a shared understanding of what it takes to keep critical workflows running. You will have a steady operating rhythm with HQ while owning a clear north star for the Content Onboarding surface area.

 - Strong technical leadership: you can represent the team’s work, hold a high engineering bar, and de-risk decisions through clear processes, delegation, and senior IC partnership.

 - Experience developing senior engineers, strengthening operating rhythms, and building high-performing engineering teams with durable standards.

 - Distributed-team leadership: you can set direction for a local team while staying tightly coordinated with cross-functional partners across time zones.

jobs.title: Asuntotarkastaja
jobs.description:
Innastutko kiinteistöalasta?

Kiinnostavatko kiinteistöalan monipuoliset tehtävät innastavassa työyhteisössä? Hae meille!

INNA on pohjoismainen asiantuntijapalvelukonserni, ja olemme erikoistuneet asuntojen, kiinteistöjen ja toimitilojen välitykseen sekä hallintaan. Tuotamme asiakkaillemme kokonaisvaltaisia palveluita ja ratkaisuja asumisen ja toimitilasektorin kiinteistöpalveluissa.

INNA toimii Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Tanskassa.Konsernimme palveluksessa on runsaat 800 kiinteistöjohtamisen ammattilaista. Pohjoismainen toimintatapamme tarkoittaa suorapuheisuutta, luotettavaa palvelua, digitaalista edelläkävijyyttä ja jatkuvaa kehittämistä.

Palveluitamme ovat muun muassa toimitilojen ja asuntojen kiinteistöjohtamispalvelut, asuntovuokraus, taloushallintopalvelut, energiatehokkuus- ja ympäristövastuupalvelut sekä arviointipalvelut. Meillä on alan laajin ja monipuolisin palvelukokonaisuus, ja uskomme, että asiantuntemuksella sekä ajantasaisella markkinatiedolla voimme parantaa asiakkaidemme tulosta.

Etsimme nyt Helsinkiin Valimotielle

ASUNTOTARKASTAJAA

Oletko sinä uusi työkaverimme?

Tehtävänäsi on toimia asuntotarkastusten parissa ja vastaat mm.:

* asuinhuoneistojen tarkastuksista vuokralaisvaihtojen yhteydessä

* huoneistoremonttien määrittämisestä sekä suunnittelemisesta ja tilaamisesta tapauskohtaisesti

* huoneistoremonttien laadunvalvonnasta

* asukasneuvonnasta

Työ on liikkuvaa, ja edellyttää siksi ajokorttia sekä omaa autoa.

Onnistut tehtävässä, jos:

Olet kiinnostunut asunnoista, niiden toimivuudesta ja turvallisuudesta. Kiinteistöalan kokemus tai opinnot ovat eduksi tehtävässä. Lisäksi hallitset vuorovaikutuksen niin sanallisesti kuin kirjallisestikin sekä järjestelmäosaamisesi on hyvällä tasolla. Arvostamme myös näyttöjä korjaushankkeista, remonttien teettämisestä ja asiakaspalvelusta. Rakennustekninen osaaminen plussaa. Järjestelmien ketterä käyttö on tärkeää tässä työssä. Myös aikaisempi työkokemus asuntotarkastuksen tehtävistä katsotaan eduksesi.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle:

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen, itsenäisen ja vaikuttavan roolin innastavassa työyhteisössä, jossa osaaminen, kehittyminen ja yhdessä tekeminen kulkevat käsi kädessä. Pääset näkemään työsi tulokset konkreettisesti arjessa ja tekemään tiivistä yhteistyötä eri liiketoimintojen kanssa.

Perehdytämme sinut tehtävääsi ja tarjoamme tukea kehittymiseesi tarpeidesi mukaan. Lisäksi käytössäsi on rajaton käyttöoikeus Eduhouseverkkokoulutusalustalle, jonka avulla voit kehittää osaamistasi jatkuvasti. Tukenasi on vakaa ja kasvava organisaatio, jossa toimintatapoja ja prosesseja kehitetään aktiivisesti ja rohkeasti.

Meillä työ mukautuu elämäntilanteeseesi – tarjoamme joustavan arjen, jossa liukuva työaika ja joustava etätyömahdollisuus tukevat sujuvaa työskentelyä. Arvostamme tiimityötä ja rakennamme yhdessä kannustavaa ilmapiiriä, jossa on helppo kehittyä ja onnistua.

Panostamme hyvinvointiisi kattavilla eduilla, kuten laajalla työterveyshuollolla ja Epassilla, jotta jaksat ja viihdyt työssäsi parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Palkka sijoittuu 2800-3200 euron kuukausitasolle ja määräytyy hakijan kokemuksen perusteella.


Näin pääset työkaveriksemme

Tilaisuutesi innastua alkaa tästä. Haethan tehtävää viimeistään 3.9.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo rekrytointiprosessin aikana.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Henri Tunturi henri.tunturi@inna.fi [henri.tunturi@inna.fi]

Työnantajalupauksemme

INNA pääset kehittymään, ottamaan vastuuta ja vaikuttamaan kiinteistöalan tulevaisuuteen – ja ennen kaikkea innastumaan työstäsi.

Toimintaamme ohjaavat arvot: onnistumme yhdessä, uudistamme rohkeasti ja toimimme vastuullisesti. Ne eivät ole vain sanoja, vaan näkyvät aidosti arjessamme. Meille työyhteisö on paikka, jossa innostus tarttuu.

INNAlla tärkeintä

Tavoitteenamme on olla pohjoismaisen kiinteistöalan edelläkävijä – yritys, joka tunnetaan vahvasta kulttuuristaan, selkeistä arvoistaan ja kyvystään innostaa niin asiakkaita kuin omaa henkilöstöään.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.



You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 4+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco and New York, the estimated OTE (On-Target Earnings) range is $145,000-$175,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.title: Director Finance, Operations & Supply Chain (m/f/d)
jobs.employer: HUSKY INJECTION MOLDING SYSTEMS S.A R.L.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Husky Technologies is a global leader in Injection Molding Manufacturing, committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our customers. Based in Bolton, Canada, we are seeking a Finance Director to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in providing financial leadership for our Operations and Supply Chain divisions, working closely with various functions including Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Central Operational Support.

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all financial aspects of our Operations & Supply Chain, ensuring that financial goals are met and that financial strategies align with the company's broader objectives. Reporting to the VP Finance, FP&A, you will serve as the right-hand finance partner to the Chief Operating Officer. This role will be based in Bolton, Canada. With five direct reports and a team of ~10 individuals based in Bolton and Luxembourg, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's financial performance.

Key Accountabilities:

1.      Financial Planning and Analysis:

    Develop and manage the annual budget for the Operations and Supply Chain divisions.
    Provide financial guidance and insights to support decision-making processes.
    Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide monthly financial reports to the executive team.
    Lead the review and analysis of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
    Identify and analyze variances between actual results and budget/forecast, insights into the drives for variances.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the underlying factors contributing to financial performance.
    Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities, making recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
    Work closely with the executive team to refine financial strategies based on month-end and year-end insights.

2.      Cost Management:

    Transform current costing and methodology standards to improve transparency to product margins, life cycle costing and governance.
    Data and process design- Defining costing rules, master data requirements, controls, reporting definitions, and system-enabled workflows.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Collaborate closely with Supply Chain leaders to identify cost-saving opportunities and implement cost control measures across various aspects of the supply chain, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and production.
    Develop and monitor cost reduction initiatives and targets, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals.
    Monitor and report on key cost-related performance indicators to the executive team, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

3.      Strategic Planning:

    Work closely with the Leadership team to develop long-term financial strategies for the Operation and Supply Chain divisions.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Assess financial impacts of potential investments in supply chain infrastructure, technology, and capabilities to improve cost and lead time.

4.      Cross Functional Leadership:

    Ability to lead Finance, Operations, IT, Service, Commercial, and regional teams through process/system change.

5.      Inventory Management:

    Collaborate with Supply Chain leaders to establish appropriate inventory targets, and improve inventory forecasting.
    Analyze the financial impact of inventory-related decisions and provide recommendations for improvement.

6.      Financial Support CAPEX (Capital Expenditures):

    Collaborate with the Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) team to assess the financial feasibility and impact of proposed capital projects within the Supply Chain division.
    Conduct thorough financial analysis and risk assessments for CAPEX investments, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals and strategies.
    Assist in the preparation of CAPEX budgets, forecasts, and business cases.
    Provide financial insights and recommendations to guide decision-making on CAPEX projects, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and optimal return on investment (ROI).

Qualifications:

    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred.
    Proven experience (10+ years) in a senior finance role within a supply chain or manufacturing environment.
    Strong financial analysis, budgeting, and forecasting skills.
    Systems / ERP capability
        Hands-on or leadership experience with ERP costing modules, project accounting, service costing, data structures, integrations, and reporting architecture.
    Excellent leadership and communication skills.
    Ability to work collaboratively across functional teams.
    Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
    Fluent in English
    Additional language skills considered an asset

The Supplier Quality Analyst will monitor suppliers' performance, organize, and execute Supplier Audits, follow-up on Supplier Improvement Plans and execute Part Qualifications.

In collaboration with the Clinic team, the Supplier Quality Analyst will support root cause analysis & permanent corrective actions.

Support and verify execution of containment actions at suppliers.

Contribute to Root Cause Analysis and Permanent Corrective Action determination and follow-up on implementation at supplier.

Support new supplier qualification.

Audit capabilities, Audit skill & knowledge, good relationship skills

jobs.title: Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our New York office.We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Organizational support: Partner with Engineering and Product leaders on running the day-to-day of an efficient, high-velocity, and fun organization

 - Calendar management: Prioritize and coordinate the teams’ operating calendar, ensuring time is spent in a way that's most leveraged to achieve our business objectives

 - Meeting aficionado: Organize, attend, and track meeting notes and action items, with an eye on making every interaction productive and warm

 - Travel planner: Flights, hotels, transportation, dining, etc. A strong attention to detail here is valued

 - Expense management: Manages expense reports for the executives you support

 - Culture carrier and community builder: Craft fun & engaging team offsite experiences, celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, new family members, and promotions to ensure employees continue to feel connected and recognized




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of Executive Operations experience at fast-growing companies, ideally with experience with technical teams.

 - Organized and detail-oriented: Strong attention to detail, able to stay calm under pressure, a quick thinker, create order of out chaos

 - Effective communicator: Ability to communicate the priorities of leadership within Notion, whether it is by written, verbal, or group communication

 - Event planning: Experience organizing team events with hundreds of people, as well as multi-day events with smaller groups of people, such as an executive offsite

 - EQ: Love connecting with employees, and have proven ability to build relationships and bring warmth to all levels of the organization

 - Discreet: Demonstrated ability to maintain complete confidentiality on all business matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're a Notion evangelist! You love the product, and already use it in your daily life



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $65.38 – $76.92/hr.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: STRUČNI RADNIK/STRUČNA RADNICA NA TEHNIČKOM ODRŽAVANJU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 10. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò'“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta 1 STRUČNI RADNIK/STRUČNA RADNICA NA TEHNIČKOM ODRŽAVANJU za obavljanje poslova domara/školskog majstora i poslova loženja centralnog grijanja na određeno i puno radno vrijeme (zamjena) TRAŽENI UVJETI: Uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, kandidati moraju zadovoljavati i posebne uvjete sukladno čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i prema Pravilniku o djelokrugu rada tajnika te administrativno–tehničkim i pomoćnim poslovima koji se obavljaju u osnovnoj školi (Narodne novine broj 40 /14, 71/25, 74/25-ispravak):
  1. SSS tehničke struke
  2. položen stručni ispit za ložača centralnog grijanja
  3. zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova s posebnim uvjetima rada
  4. da protiv kandidata nije pokrenut kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela navedenih u čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi.
NAPOMENA: Dokaz o posebnoj zdravstvenoj sposobnosti kandidata/kinje za radno mjesto pribavlja se prije sklapanja ugovora o radu sukladno odredbi članka 24., stavka 2. i 3. Zakona o radu (NN 93/14, 127/17, 98/19, 151/22, 46/23, 64/23); Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis (CV),
  • dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu za ložača centralnog grijanja,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, pisanu provjeru stručnih sposobnosti koje su potrebne za obavljanje poslova ovog radnog mjesta i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 19. kolovoza 2026. godine. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull'educazione e l’istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23), e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 10 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il seguente posto di lavoro di 1 OPERATORE TECNICO / OPERATRICE TECNICA addetto/a alla manutenzione per lo svolgimento delle mansioni di bidello e fuochista - addetto/a al riscaldamento centrale, a tempo determinato e orario completo (supplenza) CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: Oltre alle condizioni generali in conformità alle norme generali sul lavoro, i candidati devono soddisfare anche le condizioni previste dall'articolo 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU n. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) e secondo il Regolamento sull'ambito di lavoro del segretario e sulle mansioni tecnico-amministrative svolte nella scuola elementare (GU n. 40 /14, 71/25, 74/25-correzione):
  1. Scuola media superiore di ramo tecnico
  2. Esame per fuochisti – addetti al riscaldamento centrale
  3. Idoneità sanitaria per lo svolgimento di mansioni a rischio specifico
  4. assenza di condanne penali per i reati indicati nell'articolo 106 della Legge sull'educazione el'istruzione elementare e media superiore.
NOTA: La prova della specifica idoneità sanitaria del/la candidato/a per il posto di lavoro si ottiene prima della stipula del contratto di lavoro, conformemente alle disposizioni dell’articolo 24, commi 2 e 3, della Legge sul lavoro (GU 93/14, 127/17, 98/19, 151/22, 46/23, 64/23). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • i dati biografici (Curriculum vitae),
  • la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova attestante il superamento dell'esame per fuochista – addetto al riscaldamento centrale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (la cui data non deve antecedere a 6 mesi dalla data del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, la verifica scritta delle competenze professionali necessarie per lo svolgimento delle mansioni relative a questo posto di lavoro ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 19 agosto 2026.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent), in Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

Nice to have

Bonus Points

- Experience

jobs.description:
IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator 100% (m/w/d)

vor Ort Roggwil TG, Thurgau, Schweiz

• Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze

• Transparente Kommunikation sowie eine familiäre Unternehmenskultur

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen und Rabatte

Jobbeschreibung

Die kybun Joya Retail AG in Roggwil gehört zur kybun Joya Gruppe, welche Komfortschuhe und weitere Gesundheitslösungen in der Schweiz entwickelt, produziert und in mehr als 40 Ländern vertreibt. Ziel ist es, den Menschen durch kompetente Beratung schmerzfreie Bewegung zu ermöglichen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Roggwil suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine teamfähige, flexible und belastbare Persönlichkeit.

Als IT Netzwerk-Administrator / KI-Integrator sind Sie das technische Rückgrat unserer digitalen Infrastruktur und gleichzeitig Motor unserer KI-Transformation. Sie sorgen für eine stabile, sichere Netzwerk- und Systemlandschaft und treiben aktiv die Integration von KI-Lösungen in unsere Geschäftsprozesse voran. Die Rolle ist eng verzahnt mit dem E-Commerce-, Support- und Marketing-Team.

Ihre Aufgaben

Netzwerk & IT-Infrastruktur

- Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Netzwerkinfrastruktur an unseren Standorten Roggwil, Sennwald und unseren eigenen Shops in Europa (LAN/WLAN, Firewalls, VPN, Switching, Routing)
- Betrieb und Pflege der Server-, Client- und Cloud-Umgebung (Microsoft 365, Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams Telefonie)
- Verwaltung von Endgeräten inkl. Device Enrollment, Intune-Policies und Lizenzmanagement
- Konfiguration und Pflege von Domains, DNS-, SPF- und Zertifikatsstrukturen (z. B. sichere LDAP-Zertifikate, Mail-Deliverability)
- Hardware-Beschaffung & -Verwaltung (Client/Server)
- Gelegentlicher Vor-Ort-Support für Shops, inkl. Reisetätigkeit bei Neueinrichtungen

IT-Sicherheit & Compliance

- Sicherstellung der IT-Sicherheit durch Patch-Management, Zero-Trust-Ansätze, MFA und Endpoint Protection
- Incident Response bei Sicherheitsvorfällen (z. B. Phishing, kompromittierte Accounts) inkl. interner Kommunikation
- Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender in Sicherheitstools wie Bitwarden (Passwortmanagement)
- Unterstützung bei ISO 9001 Audits und Umsetzung von Compliance-Vorgaben

Monitoring, Support & Systempflege

- Monitoring, Troubleshooting und 2nd-Level-Support für Netzwerk, Systeme und User Requests
- Bearbeitung und Priorisierung von IT-Tickets und Weiterentwicklung des Ticket-Prozesses
- Planung und Durchführung von Systemupdates, Rollouts und Migrationen mit minimaler Downtime
- Dokumentation von Prozessen, Konfigurationen und Wissensdatenbank-Artikeln

KI-Integration & Automatisierung

- Integration von KI in bestehende Prozesse und Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, Kundenservice und Marketing
- Design, Erstellung und Optimierung von Prompts für generative KI-Modelle (z. B. für Übersetzungen, Kundenservice, Content-Erstellung)
- Konzeption und Umsetzung von Workflows in n8n und Anbindung an Systeme wie Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Synthflow und weitere APIs
- Betrieb und Optimierung von KI-Agenten (z. B. Gorgias AI Agent, Synthflow Telefonie, Copilot-Anwendungen)
- Qualitätssicherung und Monitoring KI-generierter Inhalte – inkl. Fehlerdiagnose, Fallback-Logik und Reporting
- Evaluation neuer KI-Tools und Modelle sowie Ableitung von Business-Use-Cases
- Schulung und Enablement interner Teams im Umgang mit KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gorgias AI)

Stellenanforderungen

Ausbildung & Erfahrung

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Informatik, Systemtechnik, Netzwerktechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der IT-Administration, idealerweise in einem KMU- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld
- Erste praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-Tools, Prompt Engineering und/oder Automatisierungsplattformen (n8n, Zapier, Make o. ä.)

Fachliche Kompetenzen

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik (TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, Firewalls, WLAN-Controller)
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Microsoft-365-Welt: Entra ID / Azure AD, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint
- Erfahrung mit PowerShell-Skripting oder anderen Automatisierungssprachen
- Verständnis für IT-Security-Prinzipien (MFA, Zero Trust, Endpoint Protection, Backup-Strategien)
- Grundverständnis für APIs, Webhooks und JSON zur Integration von Systemen
- Erfahrung mit oder starkes Interesse an Generativer KI, LLMs, RAG-Konzepten und Prompt-Optimierung
- Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Adyen oder vergleichbaren SaaS-Plattformen

Persönliche Stärken

- Analytisches Denken und strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Zuverlässigkeit
- Neugier und Innovationsfreude, insbesondere im Bereich KI und Digitalisierung
- Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten – Sie können komplexe Themen verständlich erklären
- Teamplayer mit Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen zwischen den Standorten Roggwil und Konstanz

Sprachen

- Deutsch verhandlungssicher (C2)
- Englisch gute Kenntnisse (B2) für Dokumentation und internationale Tools/Partner

jobs.title: HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d) (Compliance-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d).

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann auch an folgenden Standorten lokalisiert sein:

- Amadora, Portugal- Bratislava, Slowakei- Budapest, Ungarn- Madrid, Spanien- Prag, Tschechische Republik- Warschau, Polen

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie sind zuständig für die Konzeption, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des HR-internen Kontrollsystems.- Sie koordinieren und übernehmen Aktivitäten im Bereich Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) für HR-relevante Prozesse.- Sie entwickeln, dokumentieren und optimieren Kontrolldesigns zur Sicherstellung regulatorischer und interner Compliance-Anforderungen.- Sie überwachen die Wirksamkeit etablierter Kontrollen, analysieren Kontrollschwächen und treiben geeignete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen nach.- Sie wirken bei der Durchführung von Control-Monitoring-Aktivitäten mit und bereiten Nachweise für interne und externe Audits auf.- Sie sind zuständig für Überwachung von Cybersecurity Controls innerhalb der HR-Funktion und arbeiten eng mit Cybersecurity-, IT- und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen.- Sie beraten Prozessverantwortliche hinsichtlich Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Anforderungen und fördern die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Kontrollen.- Sie erstellen Management-Reports, Dashboards und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Führungskräfte und relevante Governance-Gremien.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Master-Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht, Compliance, Risikomanagement oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Compliance, Internal Controls, Audit, Risk Management oder Governance.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung mit internen Kontrollsystemen (ICS), ICFR-/SOX-nahen Anforderungen oder Audit-Prozessen.- Sie haben gute Kenntnisse von HR-Prozessen sowie deren Risiko- und Kontrollanforderungen sind von Vorteil.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.- Sie haben keinen Studienabschluss? Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Berufsausbildung in Verbindung mit einer qualifizierten Weiterbildung und darauf bezogene umfangreiche fachspezifische Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über fließende Englischkenntnisse, gute Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil- Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.- Sie können komplexe Compliance- und Kontrollanforderungen verständlich vermitteln.- Sie arbeiten eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.- Sie überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder ohne direkte Weisungskompetenz zu beeinflussen.- Sie bringen eine hohe Integrität sowie ein ausgeprägtes Risiko- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit.- Sie treiben Veränderungen aktiv voran und fördern eine nachhaltige Compliance- und Kontrollkultur.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist Klaus Kouril.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: Boltvezető-helyettes HUMANIC - Duna Plaza üzletbe (Verkaufsfahrer/in)
jobs.description:
RÓLUNK

A LEDER & SCHUH AG két értékesítési márkájával, a HUMANIC-kal és a SHOE4YOU-val Európa egyik legnagyobb cipőkereskedője. A vállalat kilenc országban (AT, DE, CZ, SK, HU, HU, SI, HR, RO, BG) mintegy 200 telephelyen mintegy 2000 embert foglalkoztat. A vállalat központja a stájer fővárosban, Grazban található. Nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk a hosszú távú munkakapcsolatok kiépítésére és a vállalaton belüli karrierépítésre.

A HUMANIC kilenc országban mintegy 140 üzletből álló hálózattal rendelkezik, amelyek közül tizennyolc üzlet Magyarországon található, az európai cipőipar úttörőjeként. Folyamatosan változó kollekcióinkkal a divat fővárosainak nemzetközi trendjeit azonnal elhozzuk üzleteinkbe és online boltunkba. Akár az elegáns és vonzó üzletek egyikében, akár az online shopban - a HUMANIC-nál a cipők iránti szenvedélyt megéljük. És ez már 1872 óta így van.

A SHOE4YOU a jó minőséget és a kedvező árat képviseli. A SHOE4YOU divatos női-, férfi- és gyermekcipő kínálatával a cipőpiac megkerülhetetlen szereplőjévé vált Ausztria-szerte, mintegy 70 üzletével és saját online áruházával.

AZ ÖN FELADATAI

- Boltvezető helyettesítése
- Ügyfélkiszolgálás és értékesítés.
- Üzleti célok elérésének biztosítása
- Üzletünk szabályainak betartatása
- Üzletünk rendjének és tisztaságának fenntartása.
- Üzlet napi működésének felügyelete                
- Üzletünkben lévő termékek rendszeres ellenőrzése.
- Raktárkezelés és készletgazdálkodás
- Kapcsolattartás a vevőkkel és partnerekkel
- Ügyfelek igényeinek kielégítése.

AZ ÖN PROFILJA

- Kedves, mosolygós, dinamikus, csapatban szívesen dolgozó munkatársakat keresünk, aki szívesen foglalkozik emberekkel és mindenekelőtt szereti a cipőket,
- több éves kereskedelmi tapasztalat,
- igényes munkavégzés,
- német nyelvtudás előny,
- középfokú végzettség, érettségi

AJÁNLATUNK

- Keresünk rugalmas munkatársat boltvezető helyettesi munkakörbe, Budapesten a Duna Plaza bevásárlóközpontban levő színvonalas cipőüzletünkbe teljes munkaidőben való foglalkoztatással.
- Változatos feladatok egy nemzetközi divatcégnél, amelynek székhelye Ausztriában található.
- Kedves, hozzáértő csapat, amely átfogó betanítást biztosít.

Előnyök üzleteinkben:- szakmai tréningek

- versenyképes alapbér
- béren kívüli juttatás
- teljesítménytől függően 13. havi bér.

Fizetés:- Megegyezés szerint

ÉRDEKLI?

Akkor várjuk jelentkezési dokumentumait, és kérjük, hogy kizárólag online portálunkon keresztül jelentkezzen.

Leder & Schuh Kft.
Szőke Szilvia üzletvezető

1047 Budapest
Váci út 19.
Magyarország
www.humanic.net/int

Not only do we offer a vast fleet that ranks among the best in the industry, we pair it all with a friendly and knowledgeable staff. Our employees are our greatest asset, and although we present a comprehensive equipment offering, our expertise and service are what truly distinguish us from the competition.

We pride ourselves on investing in our workforce and offer competitive benefits, as well as extensive on-the-job training for all eligible employees.

As a highly successful national company, we are constantly looking for talented individuals to support our growth. If you are interested in pursuing a rewarding career, we invite you to review our opportunities!

  • Develop new skills for a career track in service or operation management

VAS ''Latvijas Pasts''

Vecākais klientu apkalpošanas speciālists/-e Klientu apkalpošanas punktā Lapmežciems:

Palīdzi veidot izcilu klientu pieredzi – pievienojies mūsu komandai! 

Darba pienākumi:

  • Nodrošināt visas klientu apkalpošanas punkta  efektīvu darbību un klientu apmierinātību.
  • Klientu konsultēšana un pakalpojumu pārdošana;
  • Pasta pakalpojumu, maksājumu, finanšu pakalpojumu un citu pakalpojumu nodrošināšana;
  • Sūtījumu apstrāde, izsniegšana un datu ievade sistēmā.

Prasības kandidātiem:

Sinu tööks saab olema: - farmi masinate ja seadmete hooldus ning remont; - lüpsi- ja muude farmiseadmete rikete tuvastamine ning kõrvaldamine; - tehnosüsteemide korrasoleku jälgimine; - ennetavate hooldustööde tegemine; - erinevate tehniliste probleemide lahendamine; - koostöö farmi meeskonna ja teiste tehnikutega.

- teha mitmekesist tööd kaasaegses piimafarmis; - arendada oma tehnilisi teadmisi ja oskusi; - töötada erinevate seadmete ja tehnosüsteemidega; - kaasa rääkida ja oma teadmistega ettevõtte arengusse panustada; - kindlat ja pikaajalist töökohta; - töötasu suurus sõltub oskustest ning panusest; - vajalikud töövahendid ja tööriided; - ametiauto.

Sul on hea tehniline taip ja praktiline mõtlemine; oskad või soovid õppida masinaid ja seadmeid remontima; oled iseseisev, kohusetundlik ja lahendustele orienteeritud; hindad vaheldusrikast tööd ja soovid oma töö tulemust päriselt näha. jobs.description:
CCP Games is seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of Core Technology and CARBON — CCP's shared game development platform spanning engine runtime, rendering, graphics, tools, pipelines, and developer experience.

In this role, you will set the technical direction for CARBON, ensuring it evolves as a high-leverage, modern platform that creates meaningful value for game teams across CCP. Reporting to the Senior Development Director of Core Technology, you will translate product vision and organizational priorities into clear technical direction and execution. You will directly manage technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, maintaining visibility into the health and opportunities across the department while keeping teams aligned on a coherent engineering direction.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will contribute through architecture, technical guidance, and code review, while focusing primarily on raising the effectiveness and goals of the engineers and leaders around you.

The position is located in Reykjavík, Iceland.

Define and drive the technical direction for CARBON across runtime, graphics, rendering, tools, pipelines, and shared developer technology.

Collaborate closely with the Senior Development Director of Core Technology to translate product vision and priorities into clear technical strategy and execution.

Lead and develop technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, strengthening quality, alignment, and team growth.

Provide architectural guidance across CARBON, ensuring great decisions around performance, scalability, maintainability, and developer experience.

Guide the department in adopting AI-assisted development in practical, high-value ways that improve speed, iteration, and engineering effectiveness.

Shape CARBON's open-source direction to increase platform leverage, accessibility, and long-term relevance.

Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities across the organization.





Your Profile:

Significant senior technical leadership experience in game development.

Deep game engine expertise across runtime systems, rendering or graphics, and developer tooling.

Proven ability to define technical direction and align multiple teams around a coherent engineering vision.

People leadership experience across senior engineers, technical leads, or engineering managers.

Conviction in the value of AI-assisted and open-source development, with the judgment to apply both strategically and practically.

A pragmatic, growth-oriented leadership style with a bias toward learning, experimentation, and solution-finding within real-world constraints.

Experienced enough as an engineer to lead with credibility through technical judgment, architecture, and code review.

Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: COSTING ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Costing Engineer â Jigs & Fixtures is responsible for the end-to-end financial estimation of specialized tooling required for electronic assembly lines. This role involves analyzing technical drawings, calculating manufacturing costs for custom parts, and budgeting for complex automation components. The goal is to provide accurate "Should-Cost" models that ensure high-quality assembly solutions are delivered within budget.

Core Responsibilities

  • Component & Material Estimation
  • Fabricated Parts: Calculate costs for metallic (Al, SS) and non-metallic (ESD plastics, Delrin) parts by evaluating material weight, machining cycles (CNC/VMC), and finishing processes.
  • Bought-Out Items: Source and maintain price benchmarks for:
    • Mechanical: Bearings, linear rails, and precision slide ways.
    • Pneumatics: Cylinders, DCV valves, and manifold systems.
    • Automation: PLCs, sensors (proximity/optical), magnets, and HMI units.
    • Electrical: Push buttons, switches, wiring harnesses, and connectors.
  • Assembly & Validation Costing
  • Estimate man-hours for mechanical assembly, pneumatic plumbing, and electrical wiring.
  • Factor in costs for fixture testing, calibration, and $Cpk/Ppk$ validation runs.
  • Strategic Financial Analysis
  • Conduct Make vs. Buy analyses for custom fixture components.
  • Perform Value Engineering (VA/VE) to suggest lower-cost alternatives for non-critical parts without sacrificing precision or safety.
  • Maintain a live database of vendor quotes and historical cost data.
Technical Requirements

  • Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or Production Engineering.
  • Experience: 3â5 years in costing, specifically within high-precision tooling or electronics assembly.
  • Software Proficiency: * Advanced MS Excel (Macro/Pivot tables) and ERP systems (SAP/Oracle).
    • Ability to view and measure parts using CAD software (SolidWorks/AutoCAD).
  • Process Knowledge: Deep understanding of milling, turning, grinding, and surface treatments.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

  • Estimation Accuracy: Variance between estimated cost and actual procurement cost.
  • Turnaround Time: Speed of providing quotes for new assembly line projects.
  • Cost Savings: Success in identifying 5-10 %$ annual savings through Value Engineering.

BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  • High attention to detail (zero-error mindset).

Rengsi RFQ užklausas tiekėjams ir lyginsi gautus pasiūlymus pagal kainą, terminus ir technines sąlygas;

jobs.title: Student Worker – AI Marketing & Creative Content (ChatTutor)
jobs.description:
7-10 hours per week | 5,000-8,000 DKK per month | Nørrebro, Copenhagen - flexible / mostly remote | Start October 2026

ABOUT HUMAN THINKING (THE COMPANY) AND CHATTUTOR (THE PRODUCT)

Human Thinking builds tools that keep people thinking when they work with AI. Our motto is Human Thinking. AI Assisted.

ChatTutor is our product for education. It lets a teacher decide how the AI behaves in their own course, grounded in their own material and their own didactics, and lets them follow the students' conversations and step in where it makes sense. Practically that means custom PDF parsing for equation-heavy STEM material, an escalation path to the human teacher, and an annotation system that carries good answers forward from semester to semester. We are a small team out of Nørrebro, Copenhagen, working with universities and educational institutions, and a published study in Educational Psychology Review found students learned more with ChatTutor than with ChatGPT.

We build in a field that changes every few weeks, and we are now looking for a top-notch student worker to make that visible.

THE ROLE

Right now we build faster than we communicate. Your job is to close that gap. You will own our outward-facing content: showing what the platform does, what we just shipped, and why it matters to teachers and students.

Video and visuals are the centre of this role. This is not a copywriting job with some graphics attached - it is a creative production job where writing supports the visuals. You will work directly with the founding team, choose your own tools, and see your work published the same week you make it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Two recurring deliverables define the week:

  1. One short video per week. A tutorial, a feature walkthrough, a "here's what's new" clip - short, sharp, and useful. Screen recording, motion graphics, voice-over, AI-generated footage; whatever serves the story. Occasionally this may be another format of marketing content instead, if something else fits the moment better.

  2. One story or content piece per week for social media. Published across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and Oase, adapted to each platform rather than copy-pasted across them.

Alongside the two, you will help shape a simple content calendar and a visual identity that stays recognisable from post to post.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • You are currently enrolled as a student and can commit 7-10 hours a week.

  • You can produce a finished, polished short video on your own - shooting, editing, sound, text, thumbnail.

  • You are already using cutting-edge AI tools for marketing and creative work - video, image, copy, editing - or you are clearly willing and quick to learn them. We care that you experiment, not that you have a specific tool on your CV.

  • You have a good eye. Composition, pacing, typography and colour are things you notice.

  • You write well in English. Danish is a plus, particularly for Oase and Danish-facing content.

  • You work independently. With 7-10 hours a week, we need someone who ships without being managed through every step.

  • A background or genuine interest in education, EdTech or AI is a strong plus.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Real ownership of a channel from day one - your work is the face of the company, not a draft in someone's queue.

  • Direct collaboration with the founding team, including our C-levels and AI researchers.

  • Hands-on experience with the newest AI tooling for creative work, and the freedom to try things.

  • Flexible hours that fit around your studies and exam periods.

  • A portfolio of published work you can point to.

  • Compensation: 5,000-8,000 DKK per month.

HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to hello@chattutor.io with the subject line "Student Worker – AI Marketing & Creative Content":

  1. A link to a video you have made about ChatTutor. This is the important part - see below.

  2. A short note (max half a page) on who you are, why this role, and what tools you like to work with.

  3. Your CV, and links to anything else you have made that you are proud of.

THE VIDEO ASSIGNMENT

Pick one or more features of ChatTutor, explore the platform at chattutor.io, and/or go to chattutor.io/try-now and sign up to get full access to the platform and do your own screen recordings for your video.

The main delivery: make a short video that shows off your skills by presenting the platform or a feature. Choose the feature yourself - the choice tells us as much as the execution.

Guidelines:

  • Keep it short. Roughly 30-90 seconds is the sweet spot.

  • Any format, any tool. Screen recording, animation, talking head, AI-generated - your call.

  • Send it as a link (YouTube, Vimeo, Drive, LinkedIn - anything we can open).

  • We are looking at clarity, pacing, and craft, not production budget. A sharp clip made on a laptop beats an expensive one that says nothing.

For a sense of the kind of thing we mean, here is one example for inspiration - not a template to copy (shout out to Evertrace for the good work): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZF7LLqzRVSc

Here is an older video we made, and we're sure you can do much better! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lc1bExLCHOI

Application deadline: 13 September 2026. We review applications as they arrive and may hire before the deadline, so send yours early. After the deadline, we invite a shortlist to a short call.

Questions about the role are welcome at the same address.

jobs.title: Lagermedarbejder til JYSK Distributionscenter i Uldum - Natholdet
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde i en af Nordens største og fuldautomatiske distributionscentre? Vi tilbyder en dynamisk arbejdsplads hvor personlig udvikling, engagement og teamspirit er i fokus. Vi distribuerer produkter til mere end 400 butikker og online kunder i både Danmark, Norge, England, Irland, Holland og Belgien, samt franchise. Distributionscentret er i alt 91.000 m2 med plads til 214.819 paller. Vil du være en del af vores mere end 600 kollegaer?

Så er du måske den næste lagermedarbejder, som vi er på udkig efter til vores nathold!

HVAD TILBYDER VI DIG

  • En skandinavisk kultur, som skal opleves! Her har du mulighed for at blive hørt og komme med dine holdninger til dit arbejdsmiljø

  • Et struktureret introprogram, som hjælper dig godt i gang på din nye arbejdsplads

  • Omgivelser hvor ”Safety First” er en naturlig og vigtig del af dagligdagen. Vi har arbejdsmiljøet i fokus, fx i forhold til hjælpemidler, ryddelige arbejdsforhold, etc.

  • En mulighed for kantineordning med sund og varierende kost, når du holder pause til en fordelagtig pris

  • En tilrettelagt arbejdsdag med god struktur og procedurer, hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at udvikle og skabe værdi i organisationen

  • Faste arbejdstider, så du kan skabe en god work-life balance

  • En konkurrencedygtig løn jf. 3F-overenskomst samt bonuspakke

  • Adgang til fitnessrum på arbejdspladsen

  • 20% rabat på alle dine køb i JYSK butikker

  • Sundhedsforsikring

HVAD GÅR DIT NÆSTE JOB UD PÅ

Som lagermedarbejder spiller du en vigtig rolle i at sikre et professionel og effektiv flow af varer på lageret, som i sidste ende sørger for en høj leveringsevne til vores kunder ved at:

  • Tømme lastbiler, og efterfølgende placere varerne korrekt på lageret

  • Tjekke indgående varer

  • Plukke ordre ved hjælp af en scanner

  • Klargøring af paller til forsendelse

  • Loading af lastbiler

  • Leve op til vores JYSK Values; Købmand, Kollega og korpsånd

HVAD FORVENTER VI AF DIG

Har du allerede erfaring med logistik? Perfekt! Hvis ikke, så lærer vi dig helt sikkert det som du har brug for.

Det vigtigste er at du:

  • Er en hjælpsom kollega, som bidrager til et godt teamwork

  • Går den ekstra mil for at nå i mål når vi har travlt

  • Er dedikeret til at gøre dit absolut bedste på arbejde

  • Er god til at følge procedure og processer, som giver effektivitet og sikre god kundeservice

  • Har truckcertifikat eller er villig til at tage et kursus

  • Er engageret og fleksibel til at arbejde med forskellige opgaver

  • Arbejdstider på natholdet er 22:15-06:00 (søndag) og 22:30-06:00 (mandag-torsdag)

  • At kunne begå sig på engelsk er en fordel, men ikke et krav

LYDER DETTE SOM DIT NÆSTE JOB? Ansøg i dag!

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, så send en mail til DCU HR og vi vil med glæde hjælpe.

Rekrutteringsproces:

Vi behandler ansøgningerne løbende og afslutter forløbet, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi holder altid ansættelsessamtaler og på udvalgte positioner kan du forvente at få vurderinger og/eller en videosamtale om din motivation for jobbet. 

OM JYSK

  • JYSK er en international detailvirksomhed drevet af vores JYSK-værdier: Købmand, Kollega og Korpsånd

  • Vores distributionscentre sikrer effektive leverancer på tværs af Europa

  • Vi tror på tillid, teamwork og frihed under ansvar

JYSK ønsker at inkludere alle – uanset alder, kønsidentitet, race, seksuel orientering, fysisk eller mental formåen, etnicitet og erfaring. Sammen skaber vi en inkluderende kultur, der opmuntrer, støtter og værdsætter vores medarbejderes forskellige stemmer. For en god blanding af perspektiver, talenter og unikke personligheder gør os til et stærkere team.

Læs mere om, hvordan vi behandler dine data i vores, privacy policy - JYSK

For mere information, besøg vores career page.
