jobs.title: Senior Structural Lead – Naval Ship Construction; DK - Esbjerg, DK - Frederikshavn
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced structural or marine engineer who knows how to turn complex vessel or larger steel structure designs into safe, buildable solutions? This is a rare opportunity to take technical ownership of structural construction for modern naval vessels and help strengthen the future of the Danish naval industry.

Your position
Join Semco Maritime as Senior Structural Lead and take a central role in the construction of modern naval vessels for the Royal Danish Navy. Working at the interface between engineering, procurement, planning, suppliers, and shipyard production, you will translate structural designs and class requirements into practical construction strategies that support safe and efficient execution.

As the senior technical focal point for structural construction, you will influence key decisions from design maturity and production engineering through fabrication, assembly, and delivery. You will coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces, anticipate constructability and schedule risks, and help ensure that structural work is completed to the required quality, safety, and regulatory standards.

This is a visible, hands-on leadership role with close proximity to production and real influence on how the vessels are built. Your primary workplace will be in Frederikshavn or alternatively Esbjerg. The position is full-time, permanent, and occasional travel may be required.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As the Senior Structural Lead for structural construction, you will lead and coordinate the structural construction activities throughout the naval vessel production lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include:
  • Defining and planning the structural construction route from design to production.
  • Leading the production engineering process and providing technical support to procurement.
  • Serving as the technical point of contact for structural construction matters across departments and with suppliers.
  • Managing resources, supervising assembly, and ensuring adherence to quality, schedule, and HSE standards.
  • Supporting production planning to develop efficient and buildable solutions.

Your profile & qualifications
We are seeking a proactive and technically adept engineer who excels in a multidisciplinary environment and has a passion for shipbuilding and naval defence.

Ideal qualifications:
  • BSc or MSc in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Welding Engineering, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience in shipbuilding / ship construction. Alternative could be experience from large scale off-shore construction and / or infrastructure sites or process facilities. 
  • Familiarity with international classification rules (e.g., DNV, ABS); knowledge of naval or defence standards is highly beneficial.
  • Proficient in interpreting technical drawings and 3D models.
  • Fluency in English is required; Danish language skills are a significant advantage.
  • You should have a structured, quality-focused approach with excellent coordination and communication skills.
  • High personal integrity and a strong commitment to health, safety, and environmental standards.
  • Able to obtain a FE security clearance

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the planet. By joining us, you will become part of a community of over 2,300 dedicated thinkers and doers who drive meaningful change and leave their mark on the world. 

We provide the answers needed to make change real, believing that ambitious goals can only be achieved through hard work and innovative, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a better future.

So yes, working for us will spark change – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.
Apply
Share in your network

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Student Worker – Growth & Outreach (ChatTutor)
jobs.description:
7-10 hours per week | 5,000-8,000 DKK per month | Nørrebro, Copenhagen - flexible / mostly remote | Start September or October 2026

ABOUT HUMAN THINKING (THE COMPANY) AND CHATTUTOR (THE PRODUCT)

Human Thinking builds tools that keep people thinking when they work with AI. Our motto is Human Thinking. AI Assisted.

ChatTutor is our product for education. It lets a teacher decide how the AI behaves in their own course, grounded in their own material and their own didactics, and lets them follow the students' conversations and step in where it makes sense. Practically that means custom PDF parsing for equation-heavy STEM material, an escalation path to the human teacher, and an annotation system that carries good answers forward from semester to semester. We are a small team out of Nørrebro, Copenhagen, working with universities and educational institutions, and a published study in Educational Psychology Review found students learned more with ChatTutor than with ChatGPT.

The product works. Now we need more of the right people to know it exists.

THE ROLE

You will run our outreach engine: the repeatable, measurable machine that turns strangers into conversations and conversations into pipeline. This is not a "help out with marketing" role - it is one system, with numbers attached, and you own the weekly operation of it.

Most of the work is disciplined execution: the engine only compounds if someone runs it every week without dropping days. If you like seeing a chart go up because of something you did a few days before, this is your kind of job.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  1. Outbound on LinkedIn: help run daily outreach - connection requests and messages - from our team's LinkedIn profiles. Target warm leads only - a well-chosen list beats a big one. Write and iterate the message sequences, and track what actually gets replies.

  2. Outbound email: operate and scale our outbound email programme, including list building, sequencing, deliverability and inbox health. Keep every send inside GDPR and the Danish Marketing Practices Act - we would rather send fewer emails than cross the lines.

  3. LinkedIn content engine: plan and publish a high-frequency posting schedule across our team's profiles - one post per profile per day, across six profiles. Six days a week is lead-magnet content; one day a week is founder story. Coordinate around influencer posts with partners in the education space.

  4. Reddit: grow our presence properly - warm up the account first, post roughly three times a week, tell real stories, give away useful blueprints. Never take the bait: you do not debate the haters.

  5. SEO and long-tail content: produce content targeting competitor keywords and the questions educators actually type into Google. Help grow organic traffic and report on what is moving.

  6. Paid social: run Facebook retargeting and acquisition campaigns, and keep an honest eye on cost per lead.

You will not do all six at full intensity in week one. We will start with the two that move fastest and add from there.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • You are currently enrolled as a student and can commit 7-10 hours a week over a longer period.

  • You are consistent. This role rewards someone who shows up on the quiet weeks, not someone who does a brilliant burst and disappears.

  • You are comfortable with numbers - open rates, reply rates, CTR, cost per lead - and you form opinions from them.

  • You write clearly and briefly. Most of this job is short-form persuasive writing, on a deadline, at volume.

  • You already use AI tools for research, drafting and automation, or you will pick them up fast.

  • You work independently. With 7-10 hours a week, we need someone who ships without being managed through every step.

  • Danish and English both at a high level is a strong advantage. Interest in education, EdTech or AI is a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • 5,000-8,000 DKK per month for 7-10 hours a week, depending on experience.

  • Real ownership of a growth channel from day one, with direct access to the founding team.

  • A rare thing for a student job: you will see the whole funnel, from first touch to signed institution.

  • Hands-on experience with modern outbound and AI tooling.

  • Flexible hours that fit around your studies and exam periods.

HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to hello@chattutor.io with the subject line "Student Worker – Growth & Outreach":

  1. The short assignment below. This matters more to us than your CV.

  2. A few lines on who you are, why this role, and any growth or outreach work you have done before - including things that did not work.

  3. Your CV and your LinkedIn profile.

THE ASSIGNMENT

Spend half an hour on chattutor.io, then send us the following on a single page:

  1. One target segment. Who would you go after first, and why them before anyone else?

  2. One LinkedIn DM. Written to a real person in that segment - 80 words or fewer. Tell us who it is addressed to.

  3. One lead magnet idea. What would you give away that an educator would actually download, and what makes it worth their email address?

  4. One number. What would you measure in the first month to know whether any of this is working?

Short and sharp beats long and thorough. We are reading for judgment, not effort.

Application deadline: 13 September 2026. We review applications as they arrive and may hire before the deadline, so send yours early. After the deadline, we invite a shortlist to a short call.

Questions about the role are welcome at the same address.

Plastik- og Brystkirurgi på Aarhus Universitetshospital er en højt specialiseret afdeling med stærke faglige miljøer, komplekse patientforløb og høje ambitioner for patientbehandling, uddannelse, forskning og udvikling. Afdelingen spiller en vigtig rolle i en lang række patientforløb på tværs af AUH og har mange samarbejdsflader til andre specialer og fagligheder.

Afdelingen har gennem de senere år været igennem forandringer og er i gang med en ambitiøs kapacitets- og kompetenceopbygning. Vi søger nu både en ny cheflæge og chefsygeplejerske, som sammen får en central rolle i den fortsatte udvikling af afdelingen. De to rekrutteringer gennemføres parallelt, og som ny cheflæge får du derfor mulighed for sammen med din kommende ledelsesmakker at sætte retning for den næste fase.

Opgaven er at bygge videre på afdelingens stærke faglighed og gode samarbejde og samtidig skabe tydelige rammer for den fortsatte udvikling. Sammen med chefsygeplejersken skal du stå i spidsen for en afdeling, hvor høj faglig kvalitet, bæredygtig drift, forskning, uddannelse og udvikling går hånd i hånd – og hvor et respektfuldt og åbent samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder og patientforløb er en central ambition.

Jobbeskrivelse

Som cheflæge har du sammen med chefsygeplejersken ansvar for afdelingens samlede drift og udvikling. Du får samtidig et særligt ansvar for den lægefaglige retning og for at skabe rammerne for fortsat høj kvalitet, faglig udvikling og attraktive lægefaglige miljøer.

En væsentlig del af opgaven bliver at positionere og udvikle afdelingens specialer i en tid, hvor rammerne for sundhedsvæsenet er under forandring. Du skal være med til at omsætte specialeplanen og sundhedsreformen til konkrete faglige og organisatoriske prioriteringer og sikre, at afdelingen er en aktiv medspiller i udviklingen af sammenhængende patientforløb på tværs af hospitaler, sektorer og geografi.

Som cheflæge har du særligt fokus på at:

  • Sikre sammenhæng mellem drift, kvalitet, uddannelse, forskning og innovation.
  • Sætte retning for den lægefaglige udvikling og sikre høj kvalitet i afdelingens patientforløb.
  • Arbejde strategisk med specialeplanen og sikre fortsat udvikling og positionering af afdelingens specialiserede funktioner.
  • Omsætte sundhedsreformen til relevante faglige og organisatoriske løsninger og styrke samarbejdet på tværs af AUH, regionen og det øvrige sundhedsvæsen.
  • Skabe tydelige rammer for prioritering, ansvar og beslutninger i den lægefaglige organisation.
  • Udvikle attraktive faglige miljøer, hvor specialister og øvrige medarbejdere har mulighed for at tage ansvar, udvikle deres kompetencer og bidrage til afdelingens udvikling.
  • Bidrage til et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv og et godt arbejdsmiljø præget af høj faglighed, trivsel og psykologisk tryghed.
  • Bidrage til bæredygtig drift og balancerede prioriteringer i en hverdag med høje faglige ambitioner og begrænsede ressourcer.

Afdelingen arbejder med en relativt flad struktur, hvor ansvar delegeres, og medarbejdere og ledere forventes at bidrage aktivt til løsningen af kerneopgaven. Som cheflæge skal du derfor kunne sætte en tydelig retning uden at have behov for at stå med alle beslutninger selv. Du skal skabe rammer for involvering og fagligt råderum og samtidig være tydelig, når der er behov for prioritering og beslutning.

Sammen med chefsygeplejersken får du en central rolle i at videreudvikle afdelingens ledelseskapacitet. Jeres samarbejde bygger på fælles ansvar for helheden og på, at forskellige faglige og ledelsesmæssige perspektiver skal styrke de beslutninger, der træffes.

Kvalifikationer

Du er speciallæge i plastikkirurgi eller brystkirurgi og har en stærk faglig profil og forståelse for arbejdet i en højt specialiseret kirurgisk afdeling.

Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med personaleledelse og økonomistyring. Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med organisationsudvikling og forandringsledelse og har erfaring med at skabe udvikling i en kompleks organisation med mange fagligheder og samarbejdsrelationer.

Du har blik for de større sammenhænge i sundhedsvæsenet og kan omsætte strategiske og politiske rammer til meningsfulde prioriteringer i den kliniske hverdag. Du kan navigere i et sundhedsvæsen under forandring og bidrage aktivt til afdelingens position og udvikling i relation til blandt andet specialeplanen og sundhedsreformen.

Som leder er du:

  • Lyttende, nysgerrig og relationelt stærk.
  • I stand til at skabe følgeskab gennem tillid, faglig respekt og inddragelse.
  • Tydelig, konsistent og transparent i din ledelse.
  • Optaget af læring og ser fejl som en del af udviklingen.
  • Motiveret for at bygge videre på det, der allerede fungerer godt.

Du formår at kombinere en stærk lægefaglig identitet med blik for afdelingens samlede opgave. Du kan engagere dig i den faglige udvikling og samtidig træde tydeligt ind i de prioriteringer og ledelsesbeslutninger, der følger med ansvaret for en stor og kompleks afdeling.

En formel lederuddannelse er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du ikke allerede en relevant lederuddannelse, tilrettelægger vi sammen et relevant udviklingsforløb med udgangspunkt i din erfaring, dine udviklingsområder og afdelingens behov.

Vi tilbyder

Du får en central ledelsesrolle i en fagligt stærk og højt specialiseret afdeling med engagerede medarbejdere og høje ambitioner for patientbehandling, uddannelse, forskning og udvikling.

Hos os får du mulighed for at præge både afdelingens lægefaglige udvikling og den bredere udvikling på Aarhus Universitetshospital. Du bliver en del af et miljø med tæt samarbejde på tværs af specialer og faggrupper og med aktive nationale og internationale forsknings- og uddannelsesrelationer.

Som leder på AUH får du adgang til ledelsesudvikling, sparring og faglige netværk. Når du starter som afdelingsleder på AUH, får du et tilpasset onboardingforløb med udgangspunkt i dine erfaringer, dine behov og den ledelsesopgave, du træder ind i.

Om Plastik- og Brystkirurgi og AUH

Plastik- og Brystkirurgi er en højt specialiseret afdeling med ca. 140 medarbejdere og en vigtig rolle i komplekse patientforløb på tværs af Aarhus Universitetshospital. Afdelingens plastikkirurgiske og rekonstruktive kompetencer indgår blandt andet i patientforløb inden for kræftbehandling, traumatologi og medfødte misdannelser, og afdelingen har derfor mange samarbejdsflader på tværs af hospitalets specialer.

Afdelingen varetager plastikkirurgiske og brystkirurgiske patientforløb primært for patienter fra Region Midtjylland og har et aktivt forsknings- og uddannelsesmiljø med nationale og internationale samarbejdspartnere. I 2025 behandlede afdelingen ca. 9.200 unikke patienter og gennemførte knap 7.600 operationer.

Hos os møder du ledere og medarbejdere, der er dedikerede til opgaven og drevet af at sikre høj kvalitet i komplekse kirurgiske patientforløb. Vi har høje faglige ambitioner og ønsker fortsat at udvikle vores faglighed og vores samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper, specialer og patientforløb.

Aarhus Universitetshospital er et internationalt anerkendt og højt specialiseret universitetshospital med stærke faglige miljøer og et tæt samarbejde med Aarhus Universitet og internationale partnere. Mere end 12.000 medarbejdere arbejder hver dag sammen om at udvikle og levere sundhedsvæsen af høj kvalitet.

Ansættelsesvilkår, ansøgning og tiltrædelse

Som afdelingsleder på AUH refererer du til sundheds- og hospitalsledelsen og indgår i hospitalets samlede ledelsesstruktur. Du kan læse mere om dit formelle ansvar, opgaver og beføjelser i AUH's ledelsesmodel og stillingsbeskrivelsen for ledere i Region Midtjylland.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag stiles til hospitalsledelsen på AUH. Ansættelsen er betinget af tilfredsstillende autorisation og børneattest.

Forud for ansættelse gennemføres en skriftlig lægefaglig bedømmelse af ansøgernes kompetencer inden for de syv lægeroller.

Tiltrædelse er [1/12]. Ansøgningsfristen er [21/9].

Første samtalerunde afholdes [19/10], og anden samtalerunde afholdes [26/10]. Mellem første og anden samtalerunde gennemføres assessment som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen.

Har du spørgsmål eller er du nysgerrig på ledelsesopgaven, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Thomas Balle Kristensen Sundheds-og Hospitalsdirektør, tlf. +4530387193/tbk@auh.rm.dk eller Charlotte Rosenkrantz Josefsen tlf.+45 29177035/chajos@rm.dk  for en uformel samtale.

Hvis du er nysgerrig på hverdagen og ledelsesopgaven i afdelingen, tager konstitueret cheflæge Gorm von Oettingen tlf.+4529724089/ dr.gorm@aarhus.rm.dk også gerne en snak med dig.

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.title: 3-year Postdoctoral Position in Sustainable Pig Nutrition and Methane Mitigation
jobs.employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a 3-year postdoctoral position in pig nutrition with focus on climate and environmental mitigation strategies. The position is available from 1 November 2026 or soon thereafter. The position is within the research section Monogastric Nutrition.

The position
We seek a highly qualified candidate with a strong background in animal science, veterinary science, or biology. The overall aim of the research is to evaluate feedstuffs and develop nutritional strategies and climate mitigation tools aimed at reducing enteric methane emissions from pigs. In addition, the research aims at generating fundamental knowledge on baseline methane production across different physiological stages of pigs, including growing pigs, gestating sows, lactating sows, and organically raised pigs.

The successful candidate will:
  • Participate in ongoing research projects and contribute to the development of new projects focused on climate mitigation strategies for pig production.
  • Quantify and document enteric methane emissions, nutrient digestion and retention from gestating and lactating sows and growing pigs.
  • Evaluate the nutritional value of fermented rapeseed meal and seaweed products and assess their effects on nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P) excretion, methane emissions, and pig health.
  • Evaluate enteric methane emissions associated with feedstuffs, feed additives, and roughages used in organic pig production.
  • Participate in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contribute to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.

Qualifications for the postdoctoral position
  • Academic qualifications at PhD level in animal or veterinary sciences.
  • Research experience in pig nutrition.
  • Experience in conducting different types of animal experiments.
  • Skills in the analysis of experimental data and the scientific communication of research results.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, an effort to learn to read, write, and speak Danish is a requirement.

Contact
Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Jan Værum Nørgaard, phone: +4550718795, email: janvnoergaard@anivet.au.dk

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Who we are
Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor, master and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department: https://anivet.au.dk/en

Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.title: Senior Engagement Manager - Germany
Seeking a dedicated Facility Manager to oversee daily operations
jobs.description:
McLean - Erhvervsrengøring i Storkøbenhavn

About McLean

McLean is a trusted provider of high-quality commercial cleaning services across Greater Copenhagen. We're committed to delivering exceptional service standards and maintaining strong, long-lasting relationships with our clients. As we continue to expand, we're looking for an experienced Facility Manager to ensure operational excellence across our client portfolio.

The Role

We're seeking a dedicated Facility Manager to oversee daily operations, maintain our high-quality standards, and ensure client satisfaction. You'll be the key link between our cleaning teams, clients, and management, ensuring smooth service delivery across all contracts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate cleaning operations across multiple client sites in Greater Copenhagen

  • Ensure consistent delivery of high-quality cleaning services according to client agreements

  • Conduct regular site inspections and quality control checks

  • Serve as primary point of contact for client inquiries and feedback

  • Schedule personnel and manage shift planning

  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations

  • Handle complaints and resolve service issues promptly

  • Maintain inventory and order cleaning supplies and equipment

  • Implement and monitor quality assurance procedures

  • Report on operational performance to management

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in facility management, cleaning operations, or similar supervisory role

  • Strong leadership and people management skills

  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities

  • Client-focused with strong communication skills

  • Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure

  • Knowledge of cleaning standards, health and safety regulations

  • Valid drivers license

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary package

  • Company car or transportation allowance

  • Professional development opportunities

  • A supportive work environment

  • The opportunity to make a real impact in a growing company

  • Modern tools and systems to support your work

Ready to Join Our Team?

If you're passionate about service excellence, enjoy leading teams, and take pride in delivering quality service, we want to hear from you.

Send your CV and cover letter to Mcclean20@outlook.com. with the subject line "Facility Manager"

jobs.title: Maler / Painter søges – Fast fuldtidsstilling i Danmark
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Just-Clean A/S søger en dygtig og pålidelig maler til vores team. Arbejdet består primært af malerarbejde i lejligheder og boligejendomme samt mindre vedligeholdelses- og renoveringsopgaver.

Vi søger en person, der har praktisk erfaring med malerarbejde, arbejder selvstændigt og har fokus på kvalitet og et flot slutresultat.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

·        Indvendigt og udvendigt malerarbejde i lejligheder og boligejendomme.

·        Klargøring af overflader, herunder rengøring, slibning, spartling og grunding.

·        Maling, tapetsering og øvrigt finisharbejde.

·        Mindre reparations- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver i forbindelse med maler- og renoveringsarbejde.

·        Planlægning og koordinering af dagens arbejdsopgaver sammen med den ansvarlige.

·        Korrekt anvendelse og vedligeholdelse af materialer, værktøj og udstyr.

·        Sikre en ren, sikker og organiseret arbejdsplads.

·        Kvalitetskontrol af udført arbejde samt eventuelle mindre efterrettelser.

·        Løbende rapportering om arbejdets fremdrift og eventuelle udfordringer.

·        Samarbejde med kolleger for at sikre, at opgaverne afsluttes til tiden og i den aftalte kvalitet.

Vi forventer, at du

·        Har praktisk erfaring med malerarbejde, renovering eller ejendomsvedligeholdelse.

·        Har kendskab til malerteknikker og forskellige materialer.

·        Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og som en del af et team.

·        Er ansvarsbevidst, stabil og struktureret.

·        Har sans for detaljer og kvalitet.

·        Er fleksibel og villig til at lære nye arbejdsmetoder.

·        Kan kommunikere på grundlæggende engelsk.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har

·        Erfaring med maling og renovering af lejligheder.

·        Grundlæggende erfaring med ejendomsvedligeholdelse.

·        Erfaring med forskellige typer maling, materialer og malerudstyr.

Vi tilbyder

·        Fast fuldtidsansættelse.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
We're building the AI Agent OS for Advisors. Financial advisors use Verlo to replace the patchwork of tools they hate. Our agents join their meetings, write their notes, update their CRM, and answer any question about any client instantly. Interest is growing faster than we can follow up on, and we need someone at the top of the funnel turning that interest into booked meetings.

As a Sales Development Representative at Verlo, you'll be the first conversation most advisors have with us. You'll run outbound, qualify inbound, and book demos for our Account Executives. You'll work closely with the AE team and report directly to the founder.

What you'll do

You'll prospect every day: building lists, researching advisors and firms, and writing outbound that earns replies. You'll run the first call to qualify fit and book qualified demos for the AE team. You'll own inbound leads from our waitlist and referrals, respond fast, and make sure no good lead goes cold. You'll keep your pipeline clean, test new messaging and sequences, and feed back what's landing so we keep sharpening the pitch. The goal is simple: a steady flow of qualified meetings the AEs can close.

What we're looking for

  • 1â3+ years in an SDR, BDR, or outbound role at a B2B SaaS company. You've hit meeting or pipeline targets consistently
  • Comfortable with outbound. You can write cold email that gets a reply and pick up the phone without overthinking it
  • Discipline working remotely. You manage your own list, sequences, and follow-ups without anyone checking in on you
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You'll be drafting outreach, qualifying on calls, and recording Looms daily
  • Curiosity about the product and the market. You'll learn the workflows that matter to financial advisors and speak about them credibly
  • Resilient and coachable. You treat a no as information and iterate fast

Nice to have

  • Experience prospecting into financial advisors, RIAs, or wealth management firms
  • Familiarity with the wealthtech ecosystem (custodians, planning software, CRMs like Redtail or Wealthbox)
  • Experience with outbound tooling for sequencing, list-building, and enrichment
  • Background at an early-stage startup where you helped build the motion, not just follow it
  • You've used AI tools in your own workflow and get why this market is about to change

Benefits

  • Health and dental benefits
  • Unlimited vacation
  • Equity in the company

jobs.title: Unexploded Ordnance Tech II
jobs.description:
Bering-Alaka`ina Holdings, LLC is looking for an Unexploded Ordnance Tech II to support our government customer located at Andros Island in the Bahamas.

Seeking an Unexploded Ordnance Tech II to support the Atlantic Undersea Test and Evaluation Center (AUTEC) Mission in Andros Island, Bahamas. AUTEC is a Major Range and Test Facility Base (MRTFB) and the Naval Undersea Warfare Center, Division Newport's largest single team project, providing both deep and shallow water test and training environments. The Unexploded Ordnance Tech II is responsible for performing handling, preparation, post run and transport of exercise torpedoes and associated equipment in accordance with NAVAIR/NAVSEA/NAVFAC guidelines on the AUTEC project.

Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret US Government Clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance.

DESCRIPTION OF RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform mechanical and electrical maintenance and repair on exercise torpedoes (MK-46/MK-50 REXTORP's, MK-48, MOD 4, 5, 6, 7 and MK-46, 54 EXTORP's) and associated equipment in accordance with NAVAIR/NAVSEA guidelines.
  • Operate tractor-trailer, forklift, and overhead cranes per NAVFAC guidelines.
  • Conduct rigging operations of heavy equipment per NAVFAC standards.
  • Handle, package, transport hazardous ordnance material up to 1.1 per NAVORD standards.
  • Operate torpedo data extraction computer per NAVSEA standards.
  • Operate and maintain the breathing air system in support of the torpedo operations.
  • Operate and maintain breathing air system.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

REQUIRED DEGREE/EDUCATION/CERTIFICATION:

  • AS/AA Degree or equivalent.
  • Valid driverâs license and passport will be required.
  • One (1) or more years of certification in forklift, tractor-trailer, and overhead crane operations.
  • Must pass NAVOSH/OSHA respirator certification upon hire.
  • Must meet qualifications for Naval ordnance certification program.
  • Must pass annual CPR / First Aid training.
  • Must pass NAVSEA/NAVAIR Torpedo Certification program.
  • Must pass NAVFAC Crane Certification for CAT III overhead cranes, preferred.
  • U.S. Navy Basic and Advanced Underwater Torpedo School preferred.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Two (2) or more years related experience working in a torpedo shop environment.
  • One (1) year electronics technology experience or locally obtained certification in REXTORP preps and weapon data extractions.
  • Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 pounds of material or equipment.
  • Must be able to pass an Otto Fuel II and HEP physical yearly.
  • Must be able to work and wear 30 pounds of equipment regularly.
  • Must be able to regularly work in a controlled environment where temperatures can exceed 100 degrees Fahrenheit in full hazmat suit and utilizing a breathing apparatus.
  • Excellent communication skills to interface with all levels of personnel in a multi-cultural team-oriented environment.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Good personal computer and Microsoft Office products skill with emphasis on Word.
  • Analytical skills to troubleshoot mechanical and electrical problems.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Must be able to reside in remote location with limited medical facilities.

REQUIRED CITIZENSHIP AND CLEARANCE:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must possess an active DoD Secret clearance and maintain it.

Bering-Alaka`ina Holdings, LLC is a fast-growing government service provider. Employees enjoy competitive salaries. Eligible employees enjoy a 401K plan with company match; medical, dental, disability, and life insurance coverage; tuition reimbursement; paid time off; and 11 paid holidays.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and veterans. We not illegally discriminate in employment decisions on the basis of any protected categories. If you are a person with a disability and you need an accommodation during the application process, please click here to request accommodation. We E-Verify all employees.

Qualified job candidates will generally be considered in the following order: BSNC shareholders, descendants, shareholder spouses, current employees, and outside candidates. The BSNC Shareholder Development department tracks and monitors the implementation of the Shareholder Hire Preference across its operations.

jobs.title: Security Guard
jobs.description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort, Bahamas has been a playground for celebrities and discerning travellers set along an 8-kilometre (5-mile) stretch of natural, white-sand beach on Paradise Island. Connect with Bahamian beauty in an enclave of remarkable seclusion, where intimate low-rise buildings are immersed in 14 hectares (35 acres) of Versailles-inspired lawns and gardens. Wake up to breakfast on your private balcony, then indulge in a restorative treatment in one of our Balinese-style spa villas or head out for a round of golf at Ocean Club Golf Course. However you spend your day, be sure to join us back at Martini Bar and Lounge for a nightcap.

When Legends Come To Life

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club has welcomed the worldâs most discerning guests to our five-mile stretch of natural white sand beach â framed by 35 acres of Versailles inspired lawns and gardens.

Discover the legendary chic of The Ocean Club, combining elevated Four Seasons service with laid-back Bahamian style â creating one of the most sought-after resort experiences in the Caribbean.

On a stretch of natural white sand beach, our resort offers 107 ultra-luxury accommodations, a Balinese-inspired spa, and dining by Michelin-starred chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.

The Ocean Club has a treasured history serving generations of luxury travelers. Expansive lawns and towering coconut palms provide an enchanting backdrop to the pristine beaches of Paradise Island.

The Ocean Club offers a rich roster of activities including water sports such as snorkeling, sailing and wind-surfing along with land-based activities including world-class golf and tennis plus a relaxing spa.

The Role of the Security Guard III

The Security Guard III plays a crucial role in ensuring the safety and well-being of guests, employees, and property. Their primary responsibility is to deliver optimal protection by enforcing rules and regulations, as well as deterring criminal activities and addressing any emerging issues. These dedicated professionals are vigilant in maintaining a secure environment, demonstrating a commitment to upholding the highest standards of safety and security.

Key Functions

  • Patrol and inspect property to protect against theft fire, vandalism, terrorism and other illegal activity.
  • Posting at stationary positions throughout the property to provide access control.
  • Posting at checkpoints to carry out employee bag checks and monitor employees swiping time clock.
  • Control access of independent contractors and vendors by ensuring that they log in and display proper ID before entering property.
  • Control access of vehicles seeking to enter property and inspect vehicles leaving.
  • Monitor public areas and guests floors to identify and remove undesirable persons and trespassers.
  • Provide escorts for employees and patrons including escorts of cash and other valuables.
  • Provide security for special events and VIP services.
  • Provide exceptional customer service when assisting guests, patrons and employees.
  • Complete incident reports on all incidents and attend court or other hearing or tribunals to testify.
  • Assist the Supervisor with coaching of Security Guards.
  • Assist the Supervisor with the briefing and assigning of Security Guards to their posts.
  • Temporarily perform the duties of Supervisor when required.

This is an exciting time to join The Ocean Club, a Four Seasons Resort.

Applicants that are interested in applying, please note that the position is based on The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort Property located in The Bahamas and is available to those individuals who possess a legal ability to work in The Bahamas without sponsorship.

jobs.title: VODITELJ/ICA PRODAJE ICT USLUGA
jobs.description: Voditelj/ica prodaje ICT usluga – Telensa Tech Lokacija: Zagreb, uz mogućnost putovanja (Beč, Budimpešta, regija Bliskog istoka) O nama Telensa Tech je tvrtka specijalizirana za telco ICT i cyber security usluge, s misijom da poduzećima pruži siguran, skalabilan i pouzdan digitalni ekosustav – od infrastrukture do zaštite podataka. Naša neovisna komunikacijska čvorišta u Zagrebu, Beču i Budimpešti osiguravaju sigurnu i stabilnu podršku za preko 800 klijenata diljem svijeta, u industrijama poput fintecha, telekomunikacija, državne uprave, zdravstva i maloprodaje. Iza nas stoji tim od preko 100 developera te desetci ICT i cyber security inženjera. Zbog daljnjeg rasta tvrtke, tražimo iskusnog Voditelja prodaje ICT usluga koji će preuzeti odgovornost za business development tvrtke. Opis pozicije Kao Voditelj/ica prodaje ICT usluga bit ćete zaduženi za rast prihoda tvrtke kroz prodaju našeg portfelja ICT i cyber security usluga (IaaS, SaaS, SECaaS, backup i disaster recovery, colocation, mrežna rješenja, cyber security usluge). Radit ćete na identifikaciji novih poslovnih prilika, izgradnji odnosa s klijentima i partnerima, te razvoju prodajne strategije koja podržava daljnju ekspanziju tvrtke. Ključne odgovornosti •Vođenje business development aktivnosti – aktivno traženje i akvizicija novih klijenata na postojećim i novim tržištima •Izgradnja i održavanje dugoročnih odnosa s ključnim klijentima i partnerima •Priprema ponuda, pregovaranje uvjeta i zaključivanje ugovora za ICT i cyber security usluge •Razvoj i provedba prodajne strategije usklađene s ciljevima rasta tvrtke •Praćenje tržišnih trendova i konkurencije u ICT i cyber security sektoru radi prepoznavanja novih prilika •Suradnja s tehničkim i marketinškim timom na kreiranju prodajnih materijala i pozicioniranju usluga •Redovito izvještavanje uprave o rezultatima prodaje i pipeline-u Što očekujemo od kandidata •Minimalno 3-5 godina iskustva u prodaji ICT/telco usluga ili B2B tehnološkoj prodaji •Dokazani rezultati u business developmentu i ostvarivanju prodajnih ciljeva •Razumijevanje ICT i cyber security tržišta prednost •Izvrsne komunikacijske, pregovaračke i prezentacijske vještine •Tečan engleski jezik (rad s međunarodnim klijentima i partnerima) •Spremnost na povremena putovanja •Samostalnost, proaktivnost i orijentiranost na rezultate Nudimo •Stimulativna primanja usklađena s rezultatima prodaje •Službeno vozilo •Fleksibilno radno vrijeme •Mogućnost napredovanja unutar tvrtke •Dodatno stručno školovanje i usavršavanje •Rad u dinamičnoj i rastućoj tehnološkoj tvrtki s međunarodnim klijentima •Priliku za direktan utjecaj na rast tvrtke Zainteresirani kandidati mogu poslati životopis na sales@telensatech.com.

jobs.title: Team Lead Education
jobs.description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

  • Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

  • Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

We are seeking a Tax Lead to join our global Tax and Treasury team.  - Partner closely with Legal, FP&A, Accounting, and Treasury to assist in implementing tax-efficient global structures while ensuring compliance.

 - Build tax forecasts and reporting cadences that support leadership decision-making.

 - Mentor a high-performing tax team through day-to-day guidance and coaching, fostering a culture of continuous learning, professional growth, and accountability.

 - BA/BS in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA and/or Master of Taxation is preferred.

 - Hands-on experience with preparing quarterly and annual tax provisions.

 - Experience reviewing tax due diligence materials or supporting M&A transactions from a tax perspective.

 - Extensive experience in financial reporting, internal controls, tax compliance, and audits.

 - Experience partnering effectively across Accounting, Finance, Legal, Treasury, and business stakeholders to solve complex tax and operational problems.

 - Proven ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, review complex technical work, and deliver high-quality outcomes in fast-paced environments.

 - Public company experience, including exposure to SEC reporting, SOX controls, and 10-Q/10-K tax disclosures.

jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege 80-100% für die Region Grabs gesucht
jobs.description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Grabs sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Grabs

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Grabs

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Grabs liegt im Rheintal des Kantons St. Gallen und bietet Sie mit einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung an. Die Region ist durch die Bahnlinie und das Autobahnnetz gut erreichbar. Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Grabs Sie mit einer starken Industrie- und Gewerbebase, günstigen Bodenpreisen und einer hohen Lebensqualität in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Bodensee und Liechtenstein.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege rund um Grabs ist derzeit sehr hoch, da Altersheime und Betreuungseinrichtungen konstant unter Fachkräftemangel leiden. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen und können zwischen verschiedenen attraktiven Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum wählen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, passgenauen Stellenvorschlägen und dem Netzwerk zu etablierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, was Ihnen einen reibungslosen Einstieg garantiert.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Grabs

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Tipp: Laufend neue [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.

jobs.title: Marketing & Business Support LATAM (100%)
jobs.description:

For our client UBS Switzerland AG, supporting their LATAM segment across the booking centers in Switzerland and Hamburg, we are currently looking for a

Marketing & Business Support LATAM (100%)

Your role
•    Support the planning, coordination and execution of marketing activities and client events for LATAM markets across booking centers Switzerland and Hamburg.
•    Manage end-to-end event ticketing processes, including requests, allocations, nominations, tool updates, reporting and follow-up activities.
•    Coordinate closely with Market Business Coordinators and stakeholders to ensure accurate guest management, invitation handling and timely execution.
•    Organise and deliver local client events in Zurich and Geneva, including venue sourcing, restaurant bookings, transportation arrangements, event materials, giveaways and on-site support.
•    Support international and flagship events by consolidating nominations, monitoring confirmations, managing deadlines and coordinating with central event teams.
•    Handle operational event administration, including supplier coordination, invoices, contracts, documentation and post-event follow-up.
•    Ensure accurate event tracking and timely reporting for LATAM markets, contributing to KPI dashboards and management reporting.
•    Provide back-up support for digital lead management activities, maintaining data quality, monitoring follow-ups and coordinating with Client Advisors.
•    Contribute to process improvements and help ensure a consistently high-quality client experience across all marketing and event activities.
•    Place of work will be Zurich.

Your profile
•    Commercial apprenticeship, degree in Marketing, Events Management or a comparable qualification.
•    Professional experience in marketing, event management, hospitality, client service or a similar coordination role.
•    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and deadlines simultaneously.
•    High level of client and service orientation with a proactive, hands-on approach.
•    Excellent attention to detail and strong operational execution skills.
•    Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and handling ad hoc requests and last-minute changes.
•    Strong communication skills and confidence interacting with internal and external stakeholders.
•    Advanced user of Microsoft Office applications; experience with reporting tools and dashboards is an advantage.
•    Fluency in English is essential; Spanish and/or Portuguese are highly desirable. German would be an advantage.

Are you an upbeat person used to working independently within a team?
Are you a highly organised and service-oriented professional who enjoys creating outstanding client experiences? Do you thrive in a dynamic international environment and enjoy coordinating events, managing operational processes and working with a variety of stakeholders? Then we look forward to meeting you.

jobs.title: Team Leader Process Technology New AI (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Syngenta

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.

Job Description
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, Syngenta’s Hiring Team is seeking a Onsite, Team Leader Process Technology New AI (m/f/d) in Münchwilen, Schweiz.

Role purpose:

The role involves leading a team of 1-3 lab technicians in a chemistry lab while being responsible for developing and scaling-up chemical reactions towards manufacturing, including preparation and support of pilot campaigns. The position requires maintaining comprehensive process know-how for all assigned chemical steps. It also demands digital curiosity and confidence, working at the interface of chemistry, data and technology.

Accountabilities:

Ensuring the required HSE standards and good laboratory practices are applied/respected.
Overseeing and defining the experimental program to deliver safe and sustainable chemical processes that are fit for the current development lifecycle stage under guidance of the project lead.
Designing lab experiments and pilot campaigns to generate process understanding and know-how
Maintaining documentation to capture lab results and project requirements as defined by guidance.
Supporting process know-how transfers in agreement with the project lead.
Ensuring close collaboration with project stakeholders.
Supporting the department in specialist roles.
Preparing inputs for cost estimates.
Proposing, supporting, and implementing improvement projects.
Ensuring efficient use of provided resources.
Qualifications
PhD in organic chemistry or chemical engineering, typically with a Post Doc. (or equivalent experience)
Practical experience in organic chemistry.
Fluent English. German and French advantageous.
Good communication skills coupled with the ability to see trends and simplify complex information.
Track record in working within project timelines in a dynamic environment.
Experience in the fields of data science, statistics, modelling, automation or process analytical techniques or in collaborating with experts in these fields.
Basic knowledge of Python, MATLAB, or R or a willingness to learn, is advantageous.
Additional Information
What We Offer

We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:

We offer a position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
The opportunity to make a difference to process safety, both within Syngenta’s global operations, and in shaping safety legislation and culture worldwide
A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits (Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance…)
Please send your complete application with CV, diploma and work certificates (if applicable).

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner (80-100%), (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition.You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Reporting to the Head of HR Switzerland, you will provide HR Business Partner support to the Technology (R&D) and Service Divisions, as well as selected Corporate Functions including HR, Marketing & Communications and Legal, covering an employee population of around 260. As a member of the Technology Management Team, you will act as a trusted advisor to leaders and employees, helping drive business and people success. You will contribute to the implementation of HR priorities in line with the people strategy, support leaders across the employee lifecycle and take over project work and diverse HR assignments in a dynamic international environment.

Your responsibilities:

Act as strategic HR partner and trusted advisor to leaders across Technology (R&D), Service and selected Corporate Functions.

Serve as a member of the Technology Division Management Team and contribute HR perspectives to business decisions, organizational development and people topics.

Advise and support managers on HR practices, processes and policies, including employee relations, performance management, change management and leadership effectiveness.

Partner with leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, succession planning and capability development.

Support the implementation of annual HR processes, including performance management, salary review, talent review and employee engagement activities.

Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers on recruitment activities for selected roles and support effective job marketing and communication.

Use workforce and people data to identify trends, derive insights and recommend pragmatic actions that support business objectives.

Lead or contribute to HR projects, process improvements and diverse local or global assignments.

Foster an inclusive, engaging and high-performance culture aligned with Accelleron’s values.

Ensure compliant and consistent HR solutions in line with Swiss employment legislation, internal policies and governance requirements.

Your background:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Law or a related field.

5+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Manager or equivalent HR generalist role in a complex business environment, preferably experience with HR work in management teams.

Experience partnering technical, engineering, R&D, industrial, service or manufacturing populations is highly desirable.

Strong understanding of talent management, organizational development, employee relations and Swiss employment legislation.

Experience with Workday or a similar HR system is preferred.

Proven ability to advise, challenge and influence leaders at different organizational levels.

Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational excellence.

Structured, proactive and solution-oriented working style with strong business acumen and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international matrix environment.

Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.



You benefits:

Attractive compensation & benefits.

Modern office, smart working.

Flexible working models.

Canteen.

Employee Assistance Program.

Global parental leave program.

Position: ECS System Engineer
Location: Luzern, Switzerland
Contract: Permanent contract, full-time position
Salary: It will be discussed during the recruiting process, taking into consideration seniority and responsibilities within the activity.

AYES is a Switzerland-based Engineering and Technology consulting company headquartered in Baden. We provide engineering excellence across industries including Aerospace, Rotorcraft, Space & Defense, Automotive, Railway, Energy & Life Science.
At AYES, innovation, technology, and R&D go hand-in-hand with valuing human resources as a key driver for growing and sharing know-how and experience. Our teams support clients across Switzerland, Europe, and the USA.

Coordinate ECS system integration and interfaces with engineering teams (Airworthiness, Avionics, Power Plant, Electrical, and Safety) as well as suppliers.
Create and assess certification documents (reports, test plans/results), ensuring hardware and software compliance with DO-160G, DO-178C, and DO-254 standards.
Define and support integrated rig testing for Avionics and ECS controllers.
Actively support test campaigns by troubleshooting ECS controllers and system integration.
Attend design reviews, technical workshops, and support the team in discussions with Airworthiness Authorities.

Our Ideal Candidate Should Have:
In-depth knowledge of aircraft ECS systems (ATA 21).
Minimum 5 years of experience in aircraft system engineering, focusing on DO-160G, DO-178C, and DO-254 qualification.
Proven ability to prepare and review certification documentation independently.
Strong problem-solving skills and proactive communication abilities.
Fluency in English (minimum B2 level, verbal and written).

If you are a team player, have good communication skills and a problem-solving attitude and want to be part of a growing international engineering company, focus on industrial sector, with opportunities in Europe and USA, then…

SAY YES AND GROW WITH AYES!

Location: Zurich, Switzerland

jobs.title: Head of Internal Audit
jobs.description:
Head of Internal Audit  
Key Accountabilities  
Risk ManagementDevelop, implement and coordinate the organization's risk management strategy, and maintain Business Continuity plans for the organization. Introduce a culture of Risk Management supported by policies and guidance. Develop and maintain a Risk Register and ensure it is reviewed regularly by the Management Team. Responsible for the development, auditing, testing and implementation of Business Continuity Plans. Create action plans which show how these policies and plans will be implemented and undertake regular audits to demonstrate that they are effective. Ensure that relevant staff understand the policies and are given assistance and advice when needed. May oversee Group Risk Inspections.  
Quality Assurance  
Implement, support and audit relevant quality assurance systems across the organization. Assess the organization and recommend, priorities and implement relevant organizational and service specific quality policies. Make recommendations and implement an organizational wide quality assurance program based on set objectives ensuring systems and process are in place and working to meet any standards set for achievement. Ensure that all systems (IT and paper) for holding and processing customers' data are compliant with prevailing legislation. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with any quality assurance system or service quality standards. Monitor and evaluate performance against standards or agreed targets. Use audits, feedback loops and corrective action to ensure continuous improvement. Prioritize and escalate issues resulting in non\-complianceReport and take actions on the findings of monitoring and evaluation processes and make recommendations as and SafetyPlan, review, recommend and implement health and safety management procedures and practices across the organization in line with prevailing legislation and operational working practices and instill health and safety culture. Work with external H\&S advisors to ensure Omya remain compliant as a company and utilize as much resources as possible in terms of policies, procedures, audits and advice. Lead and service the H\&S Working Group, and advise and support the Group as appropriate in relation to reviewing, improving and monitoring the H\&S policies, procedures and working practices across the organization. Write and implement a health and safety plan based on external and internal audits with defined responsibilities and delivery dates. Plan, review, recommend, implement and monitor H\&S management systems and practices across the organization including, fire safety, first aid provision and safe working practices etc. Advise and support designated persons with legal compliance and the maintenance of Health and Safety manuals including carrying out risk assessments, H\&S inspections and the management of fire safety, emergency evacuation and first aid provision as required. Keep up to date with H\&S legislation affecting Omya and advise the Management on legal compliance. Ensure that all incidents and details are recorded, including corrective actions taken. Ensure that staff are suitably trained, supported and monitored by senior and local management and that appropriate corrective action is taken when staff fails to comply with policy and procedure. Participate in IMA \- Occupational Health \& Safety Working Group.  
General Duties  
Attend and contribute to regular management meetings and other appropriate meetings. Ensure that all work is delivered within the budgetary and resource constraints of the organization.

jobs.title: Courtier·ère en immobilier à 100 %
jobs.description:
Courtier·ère en immobilier à 100 %  
Depuis plus d’un siècle, nous contribuons à façonner le paysage immobilier romand avec passion et savoir\-faire. Notre force ? Placer l’humain au cœur de nos priorités et réinventer la ère d’aborder l’immobilier. Fidèles à nos valeurs d’entreprise familiale, nous avons développé une organisation agile fondée sur l’autonomie, la responsabilité partagée, des rôles adaptés à chacun et une véritable culture du feedback.  
Aujourd’hui, afin de poursuivre notre développement sur la Riviera, nous recherchons un/e  
Courtier·ère en immobilier à 100 %  
Un territoire d'exception à développer : la Riviera vaudoise  
Votre solide ancrage local, votre réseau professionnel ainsi que votre excellente connaissance du marché immobilier de la Riviera font de vous un interlocuteur reconnu dans la région.  
En rejoignant deRham, vous prendrez la responsabilité de développer notre présence sur ce territoire et deviendrez l’ambassadeur de notre marque auprès d'une clientèle privée et institutionnelle exigeante.  
Votre mission  
En toute autonomie, vous développez votre activité grâce à votre expertise du marché, votre sens du conseil et les relations de confiance que vous tissez avec vos clients. Afin de vous permettre de vous concentrer pleinement sur votre cœur de métier, vous bénéficiez du soutien de nos équipes spécialisées.  
À ce titre, vous :  
entretenez et développez un réseau de confiance composé de propriétaires, partenaires et prescripteurs ;  
identifiez de nouvelles opportunités et acquérez des mandats de vente ;  
réalisez des estimations et accompagnez vos clients dans leurs projets immobiliers ;  
conduisez les négociations jusqu'à la conclusion des transactions ;  
représentez deRham et contribuez activement au rayonnement de notre marque sur votre territoire.  
Au\-delà de votre parcours, vous vous distinguez par…  
…une expérience confirmée dans le courtage immobilier, idéalement acquise sur le marché de la Riviera ;  
…un réseau professionnel établi ainsi qu'une excellente connaissance du tissu économique régional ;  
…une forte orientation clients, un excellent sens du conseil et de la négociation ;  
…une personnalité dynamique, crédible, capable d'instaurer naturellement une relation de confiance ;  
…un esprit entrepreneurial, de l'autonomie et un goût prononcé pour le développement commercial ;  
…une éthique professionnelle irréprochable ainsi qu'un sens prononcé de la qualité de service ;
